jobs.title: Service Desk Administrator 1
jobs.description:
**SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR \- LEVEL 1**  

**MANAGED SERVICES \| TECHNICAL SUPPORT**  

**Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada**


Convergence Networks is one of North America’s leading managed service and managed security providers. We are a service company focused on helping clients leverage technology as a strategic tool and proactively protecting their business. We are fueled by providing outstanding service and sharing our passion for innovative technology as part of our integrated solutions.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Service Desk Administrator (SDA) is responsible for providing excellent customer experience by responding to and resolving incoming IT requests and alerts from our customers over the phone, through email, and in person. You will work on a variety of technical issues, from diagnosing network, server, and workstation problems, to thinking outside of the box to troubleshoot solutions and resolving complex problems.


This job operates at a very fast pace, and you must be comfortable handling high volumes of request tickets and phone calls. This position is similar to a Help Desk Analyst, Tier 1 Help Desk or Junior Network Administrator and offers many opportunities to advance within Convergence.

**WHAT WILL YOU DO AS A SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR?**

* Answer a high\-volume of inbound phone calls and emails from clients and perform initial troubleshooting on help desk tickets.
* Resolve customer tickets on the first contact, but also be able to determine when issue scope requires that a ticket be escalated to a System or Network Administrator or other support resource.
* Maintain accurate records on communication, resolution, assistance needed and follow\-up.
* Ensure customer satisfaction with service, communication and issue resolution.
* Other relevant job duties as assigned.

**WHAT SKILLS DO I NEED TO BE A SUCCESSFUL SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR?**

* Empathy, patience, and willingness to learn
* IT background with a focus on network support, implementation, and remote as well as onsite support.
* Familiarity with Active Directory and MS 365 Portal
* Understanding of networking
* Familiarity with Group Policy
* Technical prowess
* Documenting
* Familiarity with a ticketing and RMM system
* Familiarity with Event Viewer (checking for errors, reviewing logs)
* Familiarity with Windows OS and common applications
* Experience with administering current Windows desktop operating systems, Windows server operating systems, Exchange, Office 365, and a variety of backup solutions, routers, firewalls, and virtual/cloud\-based technologies.
* Experience using a triaging or priority system to gauge client issues and impact.
* Apple OSX and iOS experience.
* Ability to work effectively within a team as well as independently.
* Understanding of managed services and the value offered over a typical break\-fix environment.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written)
* Skilled at defusing high\-stress situations and facilitating resolution to technical problems.
* Willingness to learn, adjust, and grow with our company.
* Self\-starter with a positive attitude.

**WHAT QUALIFICATIONS DO I NEED TO HAVE?**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of relevant experience which may include Service Desk Support Specialist, Help Desk Technician, Help Desk Analyst, or Tier 2 (or similar) in a tiered environment.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills with IT and related hardware and software components (PCs, laptops, servers, firewalls, switches, routers, hard drives, Windows operating systems, etc.).
* Previous experience providing both onsite and remote/phone support in a fast paced, high volume environment.

**WHAT QUALIFICATIONS WOULD REALLY HELP SET ME APART FROM OTHER APPLICANTS?**

* Associate’s degree/College diploma or higher in Information Technology.
* Understanding of, and a background in working within the IT managed services provider business model, particularly in an IT support role.
* Experience with ConnectWise, Kaseya, or other similar MSP tools and software.
* Knowledge and experience working with Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft Azure and other Cloud service offerings.

**WHAT IS THE WORK ENVIRONMENT LIKE?**

* Normal office working conditions. Work requires regular sitting/standing at a desk, working with a computer. This position requires standing, walking, sitting, using hands, seeing, reaching, talking, writing, and hearing; it may require occasionally carrying or lifting equipment (10\-50 pounds) if working on\-site.
* Position may require hours that exceed normal working hours per day during peak periods; on\-call or travel work may include nights or weekends
* Position requires regular contact with others \- in meetings, by phone or by email.
* Interactions focus on data collection, problem solving, needs analysis and technical training development. Interactions are initiated in person or electronically.
* Position may require some travel to Convergence or client sites.

**WHY SHOULD YOU WORK HERE?**

* Culture of unity, transparency, and trust. Our leadership team wants you to be successful at Convergence, and we will do anything we can to support your personal and professional growth.
* Group benefits plans including medical, dental, vision, and 401k.
* Education and certification reimbursement is also available so we can help you grow.
* We believe feedback makes us better. You can expect regular meetings with your manager and quarterly conversations about your performance and growth.
* Outstanding teammates. We’re very selective to make sure we have the best staff available for you to work alongside!
* Many teambuilding and company events throughout the year so you can get to know your teammates on a more personal level, as well as kick back and have some fun (families are oftentimes included as well).

**PERFECT FIT…**


If this sounds like your type of place and you can wow us with your spectacular skill set, then we would love to hear from you!


We are an eq

jobs.title: IT Support Administrator
jobs.description:
Marmon Technologies India Private Limited

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

The IT Support Administrator (L1/L2) is a blended role combining frontline Service Desk

responsibilities with intermediate System Administration tasks. You will act as the first point of

contact for IT support, resolve incidents, manage access and endpoint configurations, and

support core infrastructure services (Intune, Azure AD, Windows Server, DNS, DHCP, Backup).

This role ensures operational stability, security compliance, and great user experience while

collaborating with L3 teams for escalations and root-cause fixes.

Key Responsibilities

Respond to user queries via phone, email, chat, and ITSM tools (Jira Service Management

or FreshService).

Log, categorize, and track incidents and requests; ensure SLA compliance.
Perform initial troubleshooting (password resets, account unlocks, basic connectivity

issues).

Handle access management and standard application/hardware support.
Manage endpoint configuration and patching (Intune/Endpoint Manager, Autopilot,

Windows 10/11, M365 Apps).

Administer Azure AD/Entra ID, on-prem AD, DNS, DHCP, file servers, and group policies.
Operate backup solutions, test restores and ensure compliance with retention policies.
Implement and maintain endpoint protection (AV/EDR) and secure baselines (CIS

Benchmarks).

Support MFA/Zero Trust for remote access and privileged accounts; maintain audit logs.
Conduct root-cause analysis and lead post-incident reviews with L1/L2 teams.
Follow ITIL processes for Incident, Request, Problem, Change, and Asset Management.
Maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.

Required Skills & Tools

3–6 years in IT support and system administration, with proven troubleshooting across

endpoints, M365, and Windows Server services.

ITSM tools: Jira Service Management/FreshService; familiarity with ServiceNow is a plus.
Platforms: Windows 10/11, Windows Server; M365 Admin Centre; MS Teams; Remote

Assist tools.

Identity & Endpoint: Azure AD/Entra ID, Active Directory, Intune/Autopilot, SCCM (nice to

have).

Networking basics: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP; file/print services; backup/restore operations.
Security: AV/EDR, MFA, secure baselines (CIS), audit logging.
Demonstrates strong verbal and written English communication skills sufficient to

effectively support U.S.-based end users via chat, phone, and email.

Able to clearly articulate technical information to non-technical audiences, ensuring

understanding and resolution of issues.

Capable of participating in live support interactions, meetings, and escalations with U.S.

stakeholders when required.

Ability to work in a 24x7 to support a global operating model by working aligned with U.S.

business hours, including evenings or overnight shifts local to India.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in CS/IT or related field (or equivalent experience).
Certifications: CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+; ITIL Foundation.
Microsoft Certified: MD-102 (Modern Desktop Administrator), AZ-104 (Azure

Administrator), Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Help Desk Administrator
jobs.description:
About Us

At Glen Dimplex Americas, people drive our success. We design innovative comfort solutions by focusing on customers, caring for people, valuing innovation, and keeping things simple. Our portfolio—Dimplex, Cadet, and Convectair—delivers trusted electric heating, fireplaces, and controls across North America. As part of Glen Dimplex Group, we’re a global leader in electrical heating and comfort technology.

Learn more at: www.glendimplexamericas.com | www.dimplex.com | www.cadetheat.com | www.convectair.ca

Compensation

Base salary: $55,000 – $65,000

Annual Bonus Potential: 3%

Reason for Opening

Existing Vacancy – Yes

Job Summary

Reporting to the I.T. Business Relationship Manager, the Help Desk Administrator is the first point of contact, providing support to end users related to computer software and/or hardware. The Help Desk Administrator provides basic troubleshooting and support, administers system and network access, and deploys computer equipment.

Duties & Responsibilities

Provide rapid response to plant hardware/software issues halting/slowing manufacturing processes
Act as a first point of contact and provide basic technical support for end-users’ inquiries related to computer hardware, software and telephone systems
Troubleshoot routine issues in accordance with protocols and procedures
Consult technical manuals, supplier documentation, and conduct basic diagnostics as needed
Deploy computer equipment for staff use, ensuring the proper installation and configuration of all components and software in accordance with established procedures and instructions
Identify and escalate issues to senior IT staff and vendors as appropriate
Provide excellent service by performing work in a professional, courteous and timely manner
Use Helpdesk ticketing system and maintain accurate and complete records
Maintain an inventory of IT equipment assigned to employees.
Maintain an inventory of all software installed on PCs and laptops
Monitor performance of back-ups and server-based batch processes
Administer system and network access rights and user accounts in accordance with network and security protocols and procedures
Provide coaching on the basic use of computer hardware and/or software
Collaborate with other IT staff on assigned projects and issues as required
Collaborate with other departments in approach to service delivery
Participate in IT projects as required

Qualifications & Educational Requirements

Certificate or diploma in Computer Science with a focus on computer systems technology, network administration, or a related field or equivalent experience
Strong experience using Microsoft Windows and Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook)
Ability to communicate technical information (written and verbal) to both technical and non-technical users
Customer-focused mentality; demonstrated customer service skills providing prompt and courteous support
Excellent organizational skills including strong time management, prioritization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities
A vertical skillset that encompasses problem identification, analysis, solution definition, results, and communication, with a strong attention to detail
Ability to work independently, as well as part of a collaborative team approach

Preferred

Knowledge of:
Dell PCs and Laptops together with HP Printers
Cisco switches
Ubiquiti Wi-Fi solution
Veeam backup solution manager
Cloud server applications
SAP S4 Hana/Fiori
Cloud based Cisco telephone system
Zendesk customer support software
Tanium endpoint management software

Total Rewards

Core Total Rewards

Fully funded Group Benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, dependent life, AD&D, short term disability, & long-term disability)
Group RRSP with 100% Employer Match up to 4%
Freedom to Choose, Consult +, and Telus Pharmacy Group
Employee Assistance Program
Workplace Wellness Program
Support of professional memberships/certifications

Additional Rewards

Educational Reimbursement Program
Employee Charitable Donation Program (monetary and product donations)
Employee Service & Recognition Awards
Referral Bonus Program
Summer Fridays
Employee Engagement Committee initiatives
Smart casual dress atmosphere
A unique opportunity to be a key player in a growing global organization
An innovative fast-paced culture focused on people

Our Values

We Think Customer – we aim to put our customers at the center of everything we do, taking time to understand their needs; creating solutions that meet and exceed their expectations, enhancing everyday moments

We Care About People – we recognize the power of a community with a common purpose; empathizing with others’ point of view and acting with integrity to create a safe and healthy environment

We Value Innovation – we are building a better future day by day; developing innovations that will create quality, consumer-centric, sustainable solutions

We Keep it Simple – we make the complex simple by driving out inefficiencies; which enables us to be agile, responsive and to get the job done

Equal Opportunity

Glen Dimplex Americas is committed to fair and accessible employment practices, including accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Please note, Glen Dimplex Americas may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as part of our interview and recruitment process to assist in screening and evaluating applicants. All information will be handled in accordance with our privacy policies, and any AI-supported assessments are designed to ensure a fair and consistent evaluation for all candidates.

We thank all applicants for their interest in Glen Dimplex Americas; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Configure l'interface client et crée le tableau de bord dans Mpex (SIRH) pour les nouveaux clients.
Gère plusieurs implémentations clients, effectue les premières paies et forme les nouveaux clients.

Consulte les clients pour déterminer leurs besoins en matière de paie, de RH et d'avantages sociaux, et identifie leurs problématiques d'affaires afin de recommander et de mettre en œuvre une solution adaptée.
Met à jour l'espace client (CRM) en enregistrant les étapes clés, les tâches et autres éléments pertinents.
Collabore avec le consultant d'affaires pour lancer le processus d'implémentation client.
Vérifie et vérifie l'exactitude des données de paie et de RH des clients.
Maîtrise nos types de services et notre modèle de service afin de faciliter la transition des clients vers le modèle de service en vigueur

Connaissances, compétences & aptitudes

Connaissance requise de l'industrie de l'impartition des RH/de la paie et/ou des PEO
Expérience des SIRH/CRM/Systèmes
Connaissances en matière de paie et de fiscalité
Esprit d'analyse
Compétence en Gestion du temps
Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale
Compétences en gestion de projet
Capacité en résolution des problèmes
Maîtrise des outils Microsoft

Required Education & Experience

Diplôme d'études post-secondaires ou équivalent; discipline pertinente
Trois (3) années d'expérience pertinente
Combinaison équivalente d'expérience, de compétences et de formation privilégiée

Travail principalement en position assise, avec déplacements occasionnels.
Capacités visuelles requises ~ vision rapprochée, perception des couleurs et ajustement de la mise au point.
Communication verbale fréquente et capacité auditive adéquate.
Niveau de concentration modéré à élevé et effort mental soutenu

This position is eligible for the following benefits~ Assurance collective ~ Médical, dentaire, vision et PAE Régime de retraite ~ régime collectif parrainé par l'employeur Congés payés ~ journées de maladie, prestations complémentaires aux congés parentaux

Manage multiple customer implementation projects simultaneously, keeping timelines, budgets and quality objectives on track.
Coordinate implementation activities and key milestones from planning through to completion.

Monitor project budgets and ensure spending remains aligned with forecasts.

Identify risks, roadblocks and potential delays, working with the appropriate teams to resolve issues and keep projects moving forward.

Keep Customers and Teams Connected

Proactively respond to questions or concerns and bring the right people together to address issues.
Prepare project status updates outlining progress, risks, key milestones and upcoming activities.

At Neon One, we believe that technology is the key to building vibrant communities of generosity. As a leader in nonprofit software since 2004, we create intuitive solutions that help small and mid-sized nonprofits connect with people, build trust, and make good happen every day.

The Data Migration Consultant will be responsible for managing the data migration process for new CRM customers, ensuring data integrity and accuracy throughout the onboarding. Responsibilities

Maintain a full portfolio of new CRM clients, serving as their data point of contact throughout onboarding.

Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

Nice to Haves

Experience in the nonprofit industry preferred.
Experience working in a SaaS environment preferred.

jobs.description:
Technicien en TI - Spectacles en tournée

Services de soutien aux spectacles

Il s’agit d’un poste à temps plein impliquant des tournées internationales. La personne retenue travaillera et voyagera dans plusieurs pays au sein d’une compagnie de tournée internationale où l’anglais est la langue de travail de la production — une maîtrise parfaite de l’anglais est donc requise pour exercer les fonctions liées à ce poste.*

Nous recherchons un technicien en TI polyvalent et débrouillard pour assurer le soutien de toutes les opérations informatiques de notre spectacle en tournée. Sous la supervision du directeur général et en collaboration avec le directeur des plateformes et des opérations informatiques, le titulaire de ce poste veille à ce que tous les systèmes informatiques fonctionnent sans heurts afin de soutenir les activités quotidiennes et le bon déroulement du spectacle.

Le candidat idéal est une personne pragmatique, capable de résoudre les problèmes, dotée d’un sens aigu du service à la clientèle et de la résilience nécessaire pour s’épanouir dans un milieu de travail dynamique et mobile.

Le technicien en TI aura l’occasion de :

Gérer et traiter toutes les demandes informatiques liées à la tournée, y compris celles concernant le matériel, les logiciels et la gestion des comptes
Fournir un soutien informatique sur place à l’ensemble du personnel de la tournée pendant les heures d’ouverture
Assurer le soutien, la surveillance et la maintenance des serveurs, des applications, des imprimantes, des ordinateurs portables et des périphériques utilisés pendant la tournée
Administrer et dépanner l’équipement de réseau, notamment les pare-feu, les routeurs, les commutateurs, les points d’accès, les VLAN, les SSID et le DHCP
Configurer et gérer la connectivité Internet locale avec les fournisseurs d’accès Internet locaux
Assurer le soutien et l’entretien des imprimantes, des systèmes de point de vente (PDV) et des systèmes de billetterie
Gérer les téléphones cellulaires de l’entreprise, les comptes et la connectivité
Veiller au respect des politiques de l’entreprise en matière de TI et de sécurité
Planifier et configurer la connectivité Internet locale avec les fournisseurs d’accès Internet locaux
Agir à titre de principal intermédiaire entre l’équipe de la tournée et les équipes de TI du siège social international, en collaborant aux tâches et aux projets au besoin
Tenir à jour la documentation relative aux rapports de ville, à l’infrastructure de TI et aux solutions techniques fournies
Appuyer l’équipe de gestion de la tournée dans les tâches opérationnelles générales, au besoin
Participer à l’installation et au démontage des sites, ainsi qu’aux opérations de transfert d’une ville à l’autre, y compris l’emballage et le déballage des caisses de transport informatiques et la préparation de l’équipement pour l’expédition
Favoriser un milieu de travail collaboratif, respectueux et sécuritaire, conforme aux valeurs du Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group
Accomplir toute autre tâche liée au poste qui lui est confiée

Le candidat idéal possédera les qualifications suivantes :

Obligatoire : disponibilité pour effectuer des tournées internationales à temps plein et travailler à l’étranger
Diplôme d’études collégiales en technologies de l’information ou équivalent
Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en tant que technicien de soutien informatique; ou plus de 5 ans d’expérience pertinente
Une expérience dans le domaine des tournées ou du spectacle vivant constitue un atout majeur
Sens aigu du service à la clientèle, avec la capacité de rester calme, flexible et axé sur les solutions même sous pression
Maîtrise de l’assistance aux utilisateurs finaux sur Microsoft Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Office 2016 et versions ultérieures), Teams et SharePoint
Expérience en dépannage et en réparation de matériel (serveurs, ordinateurs portables, imprimantes et périphériques)
Expérience pratique de l’installation et de la terminaison de câblage de réseau en cuivre et en fibre optique
Connaissance des environnements de serveurs Microsoft (Active Directory, gestion des comptes, SCCM)
Solides connaissances en réseaux (TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, routage, sécurité par pare-feu). Une expérience avec les appareils Cisco Meraki constitue un atout
Connaissances pratiques des environnements de virtualisation
Expérience avec les plateformes ITSM (ServiceNow, un atout)
Connaissance des systèmes de point de vente et de billetterie, un atout
Expérience en gestion de forfaits de téléphonie cellulaire et en soutien technique pour les appareils mobiles
Expérience en soutien technique pour Apple iOS et OS X, un atout
De solides compétences en communication en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, sont essentielles; la maîtrise d’une autre langue, à l’oral et/ou à l’écrit, constitue un atout
Capacité à exercer les fonctions essentielles du poste, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter : s’accroupir, s’agenouiller, rester debout, soulever des charges, parfois pendant de longues périodes. Anglais et français oral et écrit;

Information and Technology Services

Permanent

Today, the Royal College has over 55,000 members, and the vision remains to advance the learning for specialist physicians to deliver the best health care for all. The Royal College partners and collaborates to lead the evolution of specialty medical education and standards; support specialist physicians, learners and teams to continuously improve; and advocate for excellence in specialty medicine by supporting innovation, well-being, equity and person-centered care. We are a national, nonprofit organization established in 1929 by a special Act of Parliament to oversee the medical education of specialists in Canada.

Reporting to the Team Lead, Service Desk, the M365, AV and Technology Support Technician plays a key role in delivering a seamless technology experience across the organization. This position combines Microsoft 365 collaboration support, Audio Visual (AV) and meeting room technology support, and core Service Desk responsibilities.

A significant portion of the role focuses on supporting and maintaining collaboration and conferencing technologies, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Cisco Webex, and related AV equipment. You'll help ensure employees can connect and collaborate effectively in both virtual and hybrid environments by troubleshooting audio, video, and meeting room issues.

In addition, you'll provide Service Desk support for end-user technology, respond to incidents and service requests, and assist users with Microsoft 365 tools and services. Through your technical expertise and customer-focused approach, you'll help deliver reliable, secure, and user-friendly technology services that support productivity across the organization.

Here’s an insight into your typical day-to-day:

Support and maintain meeting room and collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Webex, and associated AV equipment.
Troubleshoot audio, video, conferencing, and room technology issues to support successful meetings and events.
Perform preventative maintenance, health checks, testing, and technology refresh activities for AV and meeting room systems.
Provide support for Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Entra ID.
Deliver front-line Service Desk support by responding to incidents and service requests related to hardware, software, mobile devices, operating systems, and peripheral equipment.
Troubleshoot user access, authentication, MFA, account, and collaboration-related issues.
Assist with user onboarding, account administration, device deployments, and asset management activities.
Create and maintain knowledge articles, technical documentation, and support procedures.
Collaborate with colleagues across IT to improve services, enhance user experience, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Does this sound like you?

Level of education, training, and experience equivalent to a college diploma or post-secondary education in Information Technology, Computer Systems Technology, Information Systems, Network Administration, or related discipline.
Three (3) years' experience providing technical support in a Microsoft 365 environment, including Service Desk operations, collaboration technologies, identity and access management, and end-user support.

Ability to travel occasionally between Royal College locations or alternate work sites, which may include driving.
Flexibility to work shifts and, when operationally required, provide on-call or overtime support.

Please note: This role is based primarily at the Royal College Assessment Centre at 160 Elgin, with occasional support required at the Royal College main offices at 774 Echo Drive. The position is full-time onsite and requires daily physical presence at the Assessment Centre.

Please apply through our UKG recruitment platform with your résumé, covering letter and salary expectations by October 4, 2026.

The Royal College invites applications from all qualified applicants. The Royal College is strongly committed to employment equity and diversity in the workplace and encourages applications from Black, racialized/visible minorities, Indigenous/Aboriginal people, women, persons with disabilities, and 2SLGBTQQIA+ persons.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Implementation Specialist - Americas (West)
jobs.description:
Mid-Market Implementation Specialist

Hi, I’m Daryl and I’m the Manager of Mid-Market Implementations at Ashby. One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement. Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering, “What is a better way to accomplish this?”. That’s why I am thrilled to be hiring a Mid-Market Implementation Specialist, specifically in the PST or MST timezone!

As a member of the Mid-Market Implementation team and part of our growing Professional Services team within Ashby’s Customer Success organization, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help shape this new implementation offering and uplevel the overall customer experience.

About This Role

As an Implementation Specialist aligned to our Mid-Market segment, you will be responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end implementation of Ashby’s solution for Mid-Market and smaller enterprise customers. Your book of business will include about 15 active implementations at a time, each lasting 4-8 weeks. You will work directly with customers to develop and execute implementation plans that ensure a positive customer experience and expedited time to value. Your goal is to support our customers, helping them get up and running swiftly with Ashby so they can achieve their desired outcomes.

Role Requirements

Implementation & Project Management: You have extensive experience leading implementation and onboarding projects in high growth B2B SaaS environments, defining scope, aligning stakeholders, communicating project plans, and delivering results against agreed upon expectations. You keep teams on track to meet milestones, work effectively in a remote first setting, and are willing to travel <10% for customer engagements.
Technical Proficiency: You have experience with complex, multi-module SaaS systems, understand shared configuration and data models, and are comfortable with analytics, conditional logic, and relational data (Ashby knowledge is a plus but not required)
Customer Centricity: You deeply understand customer needs and tailor implementations to meet their specific requirements. You build strong customer relationships by maintaining high levels of engagement and communication; you’re the customer’s proactive guide and advocate throughout the implementation period.
Change Management: You are experienced in navigating change management processes and helping customers adapt to new systems and a refreshed approach.
Best Practices & Recommendations: You take pride in advising customers on best practices specific to their usage of software to ensure optimal value.
Critical Thinking & Solutions Orientation: You proactively address thematic customer opportunities and improve our processes accordingly. You don’t rely on ‘I’ve seen this done,’ but instead think critically to solve problems.
Cross-functional Collaboration: You effectively partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations to align and define progress.

You Could Be a Great Fit If

📣 You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes.
🎧 You are a great listener. You see your role as the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our offerings continue to evolve in accordance with customer needs.
📈 You are a problem solver. You thrive at solving complex challenges with innovative, scalable solutions.
⚡️You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.
🔍 Your peers describe you as detail-oriented and technically proficient. You take pride in internal operations.
📊 You are data-driven. You use metrics and analytics to inform decisions and measure success.
🌍 You are adaptable. You can navigate changes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
🧑‍🏫 You love to coach. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help our customers grow.

You Might Not Be a Great Fit If

You bring project management expertise, but rely on other resources to be technical or product subject matter experts during implementations.
You prefer managing shorter implementations of less than 30 days.
You typically manage only a few simultaneous implementations at a time - This segment moves with urgency and we balance a book of business of about 15 implementations at a time
You are accustomed to defining ideas and strategies, yet not responsible for their execution.
You prefer working with a simple product (such as a point solution).
You prefer exclusively to build (rather than build, iterate, optimize).

Our Philosophy

Here Are a Few Key Points (relevant To The Go-to-market Side) That Should Give You An Idea Of What It Is Like To Work With Us

We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.
We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.
We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Operating Principles to get a sense of what we are looking for in folks on the team.

The Interview

At Ashby, Our Team And Interview Process Want To Help You Show Your Best Self. Our Interview Process Is Structured To Get To Know You And Your Career As Well As Empower You With Insight Into Our Key Focus Areas. Here Is The Process In Its Entirety 30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team
45 min - Interview with Manager of High Touch Implementations
60 min- Mock Call with Strategic Implementation Specialist and High Touch Implementation Specialist
Final Round:
30 min - Cross-Functional Interview with Head of Professional Services
30 min - Product Complexity Interview with VP of Customer Success
30 min - Customer Adoption & Enablement with Manager of High Touch Customer Success and a High Touch Customer Success Manager
10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

Benefits

You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.
Competitive compensation is offered.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅
Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Compensation Range: $120,000 - $159,000

Maintain clear technical documentation, standards, and playbooks.

jobs.title: Rédacteur(trice) production débutant – Assurance automobile des entreprises
jobs.description:
**L’Expérience Aviva**
======================

Individuellement, nous sommes des personnes, mais ensemble, nous formons Aviva. Ces mots prennent tout leur sens lorsqu’ils deviennent nos valeurs : Bienveillance, Engagement, Collectivité et Confiance.  

  



À Aviva Canada, nous plaçons les gens au premier plan : nos employés, nos clients et nos collectivités. Nous sommes fiers d’une culture fondée sur la bienveillance, l’inclusion et la collaboration, où votre voix compte et votre développement est soutenu. Nous ne faisons pas que de l’assurance; nous faisons une réelle différence en protégeant ce qui compte le plus.  

  

  



**L’Opportunité**
=================

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un rédacteur production débutant en souscription automobile des entreprises. Notre équipe de souscription automobile commerciale est en pleine croissance et offre de multiples possibilités de développements. À titre de rédacteur production, vous êtes chargé de collaborer avec des partenaires internes et externes pour effectuer la sélection de nouvelles affaires et/ou procéder au traitement de diverses demandes, faisant partie de notre portefeuille existant (avenants et renouvellements).

  

  

**Ce que vous ferez**
=====================

* Analyser et sélectionner des nouvelles affaires en déterminant les besoins et les caractéristiques des risques reçus, pour s'assurer que ceux\-ci contribuent autant à nos objectifs de croissance qu’à la rentabilité.
* Nouer et entretenir des relations avec d’autres services et/ou avec des intervenants externes pour offrir un service supérieur à nos courtiers et clients.
* Préserver la qualité et la rentabilité du portefeuille automobile; référer à l’échelon supérieur les risques dépassant les limites de son pouvoir délégué.
* Aider à déceler les problèmes potentiels dans les ratios de sinistre et les tendances des risques, ainsi que toute autre anomalie; au besoin, appliquer des stratégies pour y remédier.
* Apprendre tous les systèmes et programmes informatiques employés en assurance des entreprises.
* Contribuer au maintien d’un environnement de souscription conforme en ce qui a trait aux taux déposés et aux règles.
* Entretenir ses connaissances sur les tendances de l’industrie, les nouveautés et l’évolution de la réglementation.

  

**Ce que vous apporterez**
==========================

* Études postsecondaires (affaires ou disciplines connexes), AEC en assurance de dommages
* Excellente maîtrise du français, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. \* ***Connaissance du français necessaire***
* Expérience en assurance de dommages
* Avoir débuté son cours de certification du PAA ou être en voie d'obtention (un atout)
* Connaissance fonctionnelle des domaines connexes à la souscription (indemnisation, gestion des risques, comptabilité, etc.).
* Connaissance des principes de sélection et d’analyse des risques, des contrats d’assurance, des programmes de tarification, des sources d’information sur les risques, du contenu des manuels de souscription des manuels techniques, des contraintes légales et des procédures de travail avec les outils informatiques.
* Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office, facilité d’apprendre des nouveaux logiciels internes.
* Aptitude à interagir avec professionnalisme pour nouer des relations à long terme avec les courtiers et avec les clients.
* Aptitude à collaborer avec ses partenaires internes pour assurer l’excellence de l’expérience des courtiers et les clients.
* Autonomie et aptitude à se motiver soi\-même
* Aptitudes en vente et négociation
* Aptitude à prêter l’oreille aux besoins des courtiers et des clients pour y répondre efficacement.

  

**Ce que vous gagnerez**
========================

* Un programme de rémunération complet comprenant le salaire de base, l’admissibilité à une prime annuelle, un régime d’épargne\-retraite, un plan d’actionnariat, des avantages santé, des initiatives de bien\-être et des occasions de bénévolat.
* Un modèle de travail hybride et flexible.
* Des occasions exceptionnelles de développement de carrière.
* Un régime de vacances compétitif, avec la possibilité d’acheter 5 jours supplémentaires par année.
* Des programmes dirigés par les employés, axés sur le genre, la communauté LGBTQ\+, les origines, la diversité et l’inclusion.
* Des programmes de bien\-être en entreprise pour soutenir la santé physique et mentale de nos employés.

Cette offre d'emploi concerne un poste vacant existant qui a été affiché à la fois à l’interne et à l’externe.  

  



Aviva Canada pourrait utiliser des outils d'IA (intelligence artificielle) dans le but de faciliter le processus de recrutement pour, entre autres, filtrer, évaluer ou sélectionner les candidats pour un poste.  

  



Aviva Canada accepte les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées et dispose d'un processus pour offrir des mesures d’adaptation du milieu de travail aux candidats ayant une incapacité fonctionnelle, et ce, à toutes les étapes du processus de recrutement et pendant l'emploi. Si vous avez un handicap qui nécessite que des mesures d’adaptation soient prises durant l'entrevue ou le processus le recrutement, veuillez communiquer avec votre partenaire de l’équipe Acquisition de talents à Aviva afin que les mesures appropriées puissent être prises.

jobs.description:
**Position summary**

The Technical Support Specialist will assist customers with device activation, platform configuration, troubleshooting and ongoing technical support. The successful candidate should be comfortable working with GPS trackers, dashcams, mobile applications, web\-based platforms, SIM cards and basic vehicle wiring.

This position combines remote technical support, customer onboarding, device testing and coordination with installation technicians and hardware suppliers.

**Key responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to customers by telephone, email, WhatsApp and support\-ticket system.
* Activate and configure GPS trackers, asset trackers, dashcams, ELD devices, SIM cards and IoT sensors.
* Create customer, vehicle, driver and device accounts on supported telematics platforms.
* Guide customers through mobile applications and web portals.
* Diagnose device connectivity, GPS signal, SIM, wiring, power and platform\-related issues.
* Review device data, alarms, reports, video events and communication logs to identify problems.
* Perform bench testing and quality checks before devices are delivered or installed.
* Configure tracking intervals, geofences, alerts, user permissions and reports.
* Support live\-streaming dashcams, video retrieval and memory\-card troubleshooting.
* Coordinate installations, removals, inspections and service calls with field technicians.
* Maintain accurate records of IMEI numbers, SIM numbers, vehicle details, warranty status and support history.
* Escalate firmware, protocol, server and hardware problems to manufacturers or platform providers.
* Follow up on open tickets until the customer confirms that the issue has been resolved.
* Prepare simple user guides, troubleshooting instructions and installation notes.
* Assist with product demonstrations, customer training and onboarding sessions.
* Monitor offline devices and proactively contact customers when necessary.
* Support warranty claims, device replacement and return\-merchandise processes.
* Collaborate with sales and operations teams during pilots and new deployments.
* Maintain a professional, patient and service\-oriented relationship with customers.

**Required qualifications**

* Diploma or degree in electronics, IT, telecommunications, automotive technology, computer networking or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* At least one year of experience in technical support, GPS tracking, telematics, IoT, automotive electronics or a related technical role.
* Good understanding of GPS/GNSS, cellular networks, SIM cards and web\-based software platforms.
* Basic knowledge of vehicle electrical systems, including power, ground, ignition/ACC and digital inputs.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems logically and document the actions taken.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Comfortable communicating with drivers, fleet managers, installers and technical teams.
* Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office, web applications and mobile apps.
* Ability to manage multiple support cases and prioritize urgent customer issues.
* Legally authorized to work in Canada.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with GPS fleet\-management or video\-telematics platforms.
* Experience with Geotab, Tracksolid Pro, Switchboard ELD, Teltonika, Jimi IoT or similar products.
* Knowledge of AI dashcams, ADAS, DMS, ELD, BLE sensors, fuel sensors or temperature\-monitoring systems.
* Experience using ticketing, CRM or inventory\-management software.
* Familiarity with TCP/IP, APN settings, device protocols or API integrations.
* Experience installing GPS trackers, dashcams or other 12V/24V automotive electronics.
* Valid Ontario driver’s licence and access to reliable transportation.
* French, Punjabi, Urdu, Hindi or Arabic language skills would be an asset.

Pay: $22\.00\-$28\.00 per hour

* Vision care

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. jobs.description:
Network Field Technician

**Viverlink Networks Inc. \| Toronto, Ontario**  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Setting:** On\-site / Field\-based  
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area (GTA)  
**Travel:** Regular travel between customer locations throughout the GTA; occasional travel to other areas of Ontario may be required.

About Viverlink Networks

Viverlink Networks Inc. is a growing Managed Field Services Provider (MFSP) supporting MSPs, technology companies, enterprise IT teams, and multi\-location organizations.

We provide reliable onsite IT and infrastructure execution, acting as the field\-service execution layer between remote IT operations and physical customer locations.

Our services include:

* On\-site IT and technical support
* Network and connectivity installations
* Infrastructure deployments and technology rollouts
* Hardware and workstation deployments
* Structured cabling and physical network infrastructure
* Security and compliance\-related installations

Our work is performed using defined work orders, professional field procedures, structured documentation, and clear communication with remote IT teams and project managers.

As Viverlink expands its regional presence in the Greater Toronto Area, we are building a professional field\-service network and are looking for technicians who can grow with the organization and take on increasingly complex assignments.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Network Field Technician** who is comfortable working independently at customer locations throughout the GTA and can represent Viverlink professionally in the field.

This is a hands\-on role involving network equipment installation, troubleshooting, structured cabling, hardware deployment, and onsite technical support.

You will frequently work from detailed work orders and coordinate with remote engineers, MSP teams, project managers, and customer representatives.

The right candidate does not need to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting instincts, professional communication, and the ability to learn and grow.

Key ResponsibilitiesNetwork \& Infrastructure

* Install, replace, configure, and test network equipment such as switches, routers, wireless access points, and related hardware.
* Perform basic network connectivity troubleshooting using TCP/IP concepts and common diagnostic methods.
* Identify and troubleshoot physical network and infrastructure issues.
* Perform structured cabling activities, including cable routing, termination, labeling, patching, and basic testing.
* Install and organize network equipment in racks, cabinets, and customer environments.
* Assist with network upgrades, technology rollouts, hardware refreshes, and multi\-site deployments.
* Perform hardware replacement and equipment installation according to approved work instructions.

Field Service Execution

* Review work orders and site requirements before arriving onsite.
* Arrive prepared with the required tools, information, and equipment.
* Follow client\-specific instructions, technical documentation, site procedures, and safety requirements.
* Work independently while maintaining communication with remote technical teams.
* Escalate issues when they exceed the assigned scope or technical authority.
* Avoid making unauthorized changes to customer environments.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate work\-order and ticket information.
* Document work performed, findings, configuration changes, serial numbers, and relevant observations.
* Capture required photographs and other completion evidence.
* Clearly communicate issues, blockers, and outstanding work.
* Complete professional field\-service reports following Viverlink and client requirements.

Customer Interaction

* Represent Viverlink professionally at customer locations.
* Communicate clearly with site contacts and customer personnel.
* Manage expectations and provide accurate status updates.
* Maintain a professional presence in offices, retail locations, technical facilities, and other customer environments.
* Protect customer information and follow applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

Required Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate practical ability in several of the following areas:

Networking

* Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking.
* Familiarity with switches, routers, wireless access points, and network cabling.
* Ability to perform basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand IP addressing, Ethernet, VLAN concepts, and common network terminology.

Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure

* Experience with structured cabling.
* Ability to terminate, label, organize, and test network cables.
* Familiarity with patch panels, racks, cable management, and physical network infrastructure.
* Ability to use basic field testing and hand tools.

Troubleshooting

* Ability to systematically identify the cause of technical problems.
* Comfortable troubleshooting connectivity, hardware, cabling, and physical infrastructure issues.
* Able to distinguish between issues that can be resolved onsite and those requiring escalation.

Field Service

* Comfortable working independently at customer sites.
* Able to follow work orders and technical instructions accurately.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Reliable and punctual.
* Comfortable travelling between customer locations throughout the GTA.

Communication

* Professional verbal and written communication.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical personnel.
* Able to provide concise and accurate field updates.

Assets / Preferred Qualifications

The following are considered assets but are **not mandatory**:

* CompTIA Network\+
* Cisco CCNA or equivalent training
* Experience with enterprise networking equipment
* Experience with wireless networking
* Experience with fiber optic infrastructure
* Experience with POS

jobs.title: Data Migration Specialist
jobs.description:
Data Migration Specialist


**Location**: ST. JOHN'S, Newfoundland and Labrador or Remote



ClearRisk empowers our customers by optimizing risk and improving safety for their employees and the general public. We keep people from harm and help our customers be more successful. Our cloud\-based claims and risk management solutions provide customers with a suite of tools and insights built for industries such as municipalities, utilities, real estate/property groups, manufacturers, retailers and more. Our solutions lower insurance and risk management costs while giving meaningful data insights that drive business growth.


**About the Role**



ClearRisk's implementation work involves moving customer data – often complex, agency\- or municipality\-specific data – into our platform's data model. This role exists to own the accuracy and integrity of that process: defining how source data maps to our data model, verifying that mappings and transformations are correct, and executing migrations directly using our ETL tooling.



This is not strictly a software development role, nor is it a traditional test/QA role. It is a role for someone who is obsessed with getting data right, and who wants to understand *why* a field maps where it does, *why* a transformation is needed, and *what* value it provides for the customer – not just confirm that a process ran without error.


**What You'll Do**


* Participate in requirements gathering and define source\-to\-target data mapping specifications for customer integration and migration projects, in partnership with the Business Analyst and other Implementation team members
* Own quality verification of data mappings and transformations – both pre\-load and post\-load – ensuring data lands correctly, cleanly, and in a way that reflects the customer's actual business need
* Execute standard migrations/integrations directly using ClearRisk's internal ETL tooling (Excel\-competency level of complexity)
* Partner with developers on complex, custom\-coded integration builds, validating that implemented mappings match the intended specification and that output data is correct (a QA/validation role on these projects, not a build role)
* Document mapping decisions and transformation logic clearly enough that intent ("why this maps here") is understood by others, not just the mechanics
* Flag data quality issues, mapping ambiguities, or edge cases for resolution


**What You'll Bring**


* Strong Excel/spreadsheet fluency; comfort with ETL\-style tooling
* Demonstrated obsession with data accuracy/quality, ideally with examples of catching subtle data issues and not just obvious ones
* Ability to understand and question business context – why a piece of data matters, not just where it goes
* Comfortable working closely with developers without being one. Can read a data model, ask good questions, and evaluate output without writing code
* Data\-focused coding experience (Python, SQL, etc.) would be an advantage
* Experience with AI\-assisted tooling (e.g. using LLMs to safely assist with mapping suggestions, data review, or documentation) would be beneficial
* Experience with handling sensitive data in regulated environments (e.g. PII/PHI, healthcare, financial services, government) would be a bonus, as the data this role touches can be sensitive in nature
* Familiarity with insurance and risk management would be a plus


We are looking for a driven individual who is motivated to build their career. This is a full\-time permanent position with a competitive salary, benefits package and more.



ClearRisk may use AI\-enabled tools to support parts of the recruitment process, including reviewing and assessing applications. Human team members are involved throughout the hiring process, and all decisions about candidate progression and selection are made by people. If you have any questions or require accommodation, please contact the hiring contact at ddunne@clearrisk.com

Our mission is to build brands people believe in by delivering elevated experiences in all we do. Through uncompromising quality, purposeful innovation, and trusted partnerships, we create products and relationships that enrich lives and help shape the future of cannabis.

  

The IT Technician supports the reliable and efficient delivery of day\-to\-day technology services across Rubicon Organics. Working under the guidance of senior IT team members, this role provides responsive end\-user.


support, maintains endpoint hardware and software, completes routine operational tasks, and documents solutions. By resolving common incidents, escalating complex or recurring issues, and helping employees use technology effectively, the role contributes to productivity, service continuity, and the organization’s security practices.


Based primarily at our Pacifica facility in Delta, BC, with travel to Hope and Downtown Vancouver several times per month, reporting to the Senior IT Manager.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Provide timely and courteous technical support to employees through email, phone, remote tools, and face\-to\-face communication.
* Use the IT ticketing system to record, prioritize, troubleshoot, resolve, and document technology incidents and service requests within established service expectations.
* Set up, configure, deploy, and support end\-user devices, peripherals, applications, and user access using approved standards and procedures.
* Perform routine updates, upgrades, and maintenance of endpoint devices using tools such as Microsoft Intune, NinjaOne, and other approved device\-management platforms.
* Troubleshoot common hardware, software, printing, connectivity, account, and endpoint\-management issues, escalating more complex matters with complete and accurate information.
* Monitor assigned endpoint, identity, and email\-security alerts; complete initial investigation and escalate confirmed or higher\-risk issues in accordance with IT procedures.
* Support employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding by preparing equipment, coordinating access, and completing assigned checklist activities.
* Maintain accurate inventory and lifecycle records for IT hardware, software, accessories, and assigned equipment.
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation, knowledge articles, setup instructions, and standard operating procedures for employees and the IT team.
* Identify recurring incidents and service requests, communicate trends to senior IT team members, and contribute to practical improvements that reduce repeat issues.
* Assist with testing and implementing approved changes to existing systems, applications, and workplace technology.
* Work collaboratively with employees, vendors, and other departments to ensure users have the appropriate and secure technology tools to perform their work effectively.
* Follow established IT policies, security practices, change controls, and escalation procedures, and assist with other IT operational tasks as assigned.

 **What You Bring**

* Post\-secondary diploma, certificate, or degree in information technology, computer systems, networking, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, training, and practical experience will be considered.
* Up to two years of related experience in IT support, service desk, desktop support, or technology operations; relevant co\-op, internship, practicum, or hands\-on lab experience is valued.
* Foundational knowledge of Windows and macOS devices, Microsoft 365 applications, user accounts, endpoint configuration, and common workplace hardware and software.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, including Wi\-Fi, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, switches, and access points.
* Exposure to Cisco, Juniper, Ubiquiti, Aruba, pfSense networking equipment is an asset
* Exposure to endpoint\-management tools such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, NinjaOne, is an asset.
* Awareness of cybersecurity fundamentals, including phishing, password and identity protection, device compliance, least\-privilege access, and appropriate incident escalation.
* Exposure to EDR/XDR tools such as Crowdstrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint is an asset.
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, follow documented procedures, capture accurate details, and recognize then to seek assistance or escalate an issue.
* Strong customer\-service, communication, organization, and time\-management skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to non\-technical users.
* Demonstrated curiosity, attention to detail, discretion when handling confidential information, and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced environment.
* Entry\-level certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Microsoft fundamentals, or equivalent training are assets but are not required.
* A valid driver’s licence and access to a reliable vehicle are required, as our Delta and Hope locations are not accessible by public transit.

 **Why Rubicon**

Rubicon Organics is Canada's leader in premium, certified organic cannabis and a fast\-growing company with strong momentum, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. You'll join a collaborative, high\-performing team that values accountability, speed, and continuous improvement, where you'll have direct visibility into the results of your work and the chance to learn and contribute across multiple functions. It's a quality\-driven culture where innovation, ownership, and growth are at the heart of everything we do.

  

* Base salary of $60K–$75K depending on experience.
* Annual performance bonus of up to 10%.
* Monthly phone stipend of up to $70\.
* Comprehensive medical and dental benefits after three months.
* Annual 3\-week vacation to start.
* Flexible in office hours.
* Dog\-friendly office because great teams include four\-legged cowo

jobs.title: Junior Help Desk Technician
jobs.description:
Thomson Rogers LLP is seeking a Junior Help Desk Technician to join its IT group.


**About Us:**
-------------


With over 90 years of practice, Thomson Rogers LLP is one of Ontario’s most trusted and long\-standing law firms. Since 1935, the firm has represented individuals and families facing life\-altering injuries and complex legal challenges. Our lawyers lead high\-stakes cases in personal injury, medical malpractice, family law, along with municipal, planning, and expropriation law.


**Description of the Role:**
----------------------------


The Junior Help Desk Technician role is to deliver support to end users in the organization concerning the use of various types of software programs efficiently and effectively in fulfilling business objectives. This includes troubleshooting applications and hardware issues for all staff members.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Field incoming calls from end users and resolve application and hardware issues
* Perform hands\-on fixes at the desktop level, under the direction of the Network Administrator and/or Director of IT
* Record, track, and document the problem\-solving process, including all successful and unsuccessful decisions made, and actions taken, through to final resolution
* Communicate application problems and issues to team leaders
* Test fixes and perform post\-resolution follow\-ups to ensure problems have been adequately resolved
* Identify and learn appropriate software applications used and supported by the organization
* Administer new hire technology needs (e.g., desktop imaging, account creation)
* Perform preventative maintenance, including the installation of service packs, patches, hot fixes, anti\-virus software, and other security\-related updates as directed by team leaders
* Apply diagnostic utilities to aid in troubleshooting
* Assist in maintaining cybersecurity best practices, including endpoint protection, phishing awareness, and access control policies
* Support additional IT projects and administrative tasks as required

**Education and Experience Requirements:**
------------------------------------------


* College Diploma or related work experience
* One to two years’ experience providing Help Desk support or client support in a professional or similar environment
* Must be proficient in using Microsoft Office to aid end users in resolving issues
* Must have experience working in a Microsoft 365 environment
* Must have experience working with Windows 10, 11 in an AD domain environment
* Lotus Notes/Domino experience a definite asset
* Knowledge of Apple and Android mobile devices and overall mobile device management; experience with Intune is required
* Experience with Zoom, Zoom rooms, and Poly devices is a plus
* An interest in cybersecurity or relevant education/certifications (e.g., Security\+, Microsoft SC\-900, or similar) is highly desirable
* Excellent troubleshooting, organization, communication (both verbal and written), and customer service skills
* Strong attention to detail, flexible, able to multitask, and adapt while staying calm in a fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment
* Desire to remain up\-to\-date with current and future technologies emerging in the industry
* Technical hardware skills a definite asset
* Excellent interpersonal and time management skills
* Excellent analytical skills combined with adaptability would be an asset
* A service\-oriented professional who takes pride in providing responsive and effective support
* Previous exposure to working in the legal environment would be an asset
* Collaborative, approachable, and able to build positive working relationships across the firm

**Employment Details:**
-----------------------


* Employment type: Full\-time
* Vacancy reason: Replacement of an employee who resigned

**Administrative Items:**
-------------------------


* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation time off
* Employer\-paid benefit coverage, including a Health Spending Account
* This role is on\-site for the 3\-month onboarding period. Upon completion of onboarding, employees may be eligible for one remote workday per week, depending on business and project needs.

**Expected Compensation Range:**
--------------------------------

$55,000 – $65,000 CAD


At Thomson Rogers, we recognize that exceptional talent comes in many forms. Compensation will be tailored to reflect your experience, skill set, and the impact you are ready to make in this role.


**Hiring Approach:**
--------------------

From résumé review to in‑person interviews, every step of our hiring process is guided by HR at this time.


We thank all applicants in advance for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.


**How to apply**
----------------


We invite all candidates to submit their resume to Alison Russell , HR Specialist.


**Thomson Rogers LLP**  

390 Bay Street, Suite 3100
  

Toronto, ON

jobs.title: MSP Network Technician
jobs.description:
**About XBASE**

XBASE has managed IT infrastructure for Canadian organizations since 1988\. We run three geographically dispersed Tier 3 data centres, and a 24/7/365 live answered support desk.

We are 100% Canadian and 100% in house. No offshoring, no subcontracting. Every ticket, every project and every escalation is handled by someone on our Toronto team. That model only works if the people we hire are strong, so we hire carefully and we keep people for a long time. Several of our client relationships run past 30 years, and so do several of our staff.

**The role**

You will build, configure and support the networks that our clients run their businesses on. This is hands on work: switches, firewalls, routing, wireless, VPN, structured cabling coordination, and the Linux systems that sit behind them. Some days you are in the office working tickets and change requests. Some days you are at a client site or in one of our data centres racking and cabling gear.

We are looking for someone who fixes the cause rather than the symptom. If a client calls us three times about the same problem, we treat that as our failure, not theirs. The technicians who do well here are the ones who dig until they understand what actually happened, then close the gap so it does not happen again.

You will report to the Director of Network Operations.

What you will do

* Configure, deploy and support Cisco and Fortinet networks: switching, routing, FortiGate firewall policy, SD\-WAN, IPsec VPN, ZTNA
* Deploy and support wireless infrastructure, including site surveys, AP placement and RF troubleshooting
* Build and maintain Linux servers and appliances (Ubuntu) used for monitoring, automation and infrastructure services
* Write and maintain Ansible playbooks and roles that push configuration to network devices and Linux hosts, so that builds are repeatable rather than hand crafted
* Take escalations from the service desk, diagnose to root cause and document the fix
* Execute network changes during scheduled after hours windows, with rollback plans written before the window opens
* Rack, cable, label and document equipment in client sites and in XBASE data centres
* Keep network documentation, diagrams and IP address management current
* Contribute to project work: office moves, firewall replacements, circuit cutovers, ISP and carrier coordination
* Work within our SOC 2 Type II controls, including change management and evidence capture

**What you need**

* Solid hands on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise networks in production, not just in a lab
* Working knowledge of Cisco switching and routing: VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, static and dynamic routing, port security
* Working knowledge of Fortinet: FortiGate policy and NAT, VPN configuration, FortiSwitch and FortiAP where present
* Comfort on the Linux command line: package management, systemd, networking stack, SSH key management, log analysis
* Practical Ansible experience, or strong scripting experience plus a clear willingness to move to Ansible quickly
* The ability to read a packet capture and reason about what the network is actually doing
* Clear written English. Documentation and ticket notes are part of the job, not an afterthought
* Legal eligibility to work in Canada
* A valid Ontario driver's licence and access to a vehicle, for client site and data centre visits
* Willingness to complete a criminal record check, credit check and consent to client mandated background screening, as required by our SOC 2 Type II controls and several client contracts

**What helps**

* Certifications: CCNA or CCNP, NSE 4 or higher, RHCSA, Network\+
* Experience in an MSP or other multi client environment
* Experience with Ruckus wireless, Ubiquiti
* Familiarity with virtualization (VMware, Proxmox, Hyper\-V) and storage concepts
* Exposure to Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune in a hybrid environment
* Git, CI pipelines, or any experience treating infrastructure as code

What we offer

* $45,000 to $52,000 per year, reviewed annually
* \[Health, dental and vision benefits]
* \[Paid vacation and personal days]
* \[Paid certification and exam costs]
* Real equipment, real budgets and a lab where you are expected to break things before clients see them
* A team that has been doing this since 1988 and has no interest in growing by cutting corners

Pay: $45,000\.00\-$52,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Company events
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Discounted or free food
* Life insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* On\-site parking

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About Benson Cabinetry \& Millwork**

Benson Cabinetry \& Millwork is a leading custom millwork and cabinetry manufacturer based in Victoria, British Columbia. For over 50 years, we have partnered with builders, developers, designers, and homeowners to deliver high\-quality architectural millwork and cabinetry solutions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. We take pride in our craftsmanship, innovation, and collaborative approach, fostering a workplace where skilled professionals can grow their careers while contributing to exceptional projects throughout Vancouver, Vancouver Island and beyond.

**Contract**: 3\-months, with the possibility of being extended or going permanent

**Hourly Rate**: $27 \- $32, based on experience

**Location**: Victoria area, various job sites

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Field Technician, Service specializing in Cabinetry and Millwork to join our team. In this role, you will be the hands\-on expert responsible for installing, repairing, and maintaining custom cabinetry, millwork, and related woodwork in various client locations. Your expertise will ensure that each project meets our high standards of quality, precision, and craftsmanship.

**Reports to:** Field Operations Manager/Field Foremen

**Key Responsibilities**

**Installation \& Finishing**

* Install, adjust, and scribe cabinets, kicks, fillers, gables, and handles.
* Perform minor finishing repairs and adjustments.
* Create jigs as needed for accurate handle installation.
* Ensure all units meet contractual quality standards and are left clean and free of debris.

**Site Coordination \& Communication**

* Work collaboratively with the installation team and other trades.
* Communicate supply needs, potential challenges, and site issues promptly.
* Maintain positive client relations with Site Superintendents, owners, and trades.
* Attend site meetings when required.

**Documentation \& Tracking**

* Accurately track installed units, site changes, rectifications, mileage, and expenses.
* Ensure adherence to BCM quality and safety standards (including COR, work\-alone, and safe driving policies).
* Maintain required software proficiency (Word, Outlook, Excel; Closeout experience is an asset).
* Assist in developing standard operating procedures when needed.

**Logistics \& Materials Management**

* Ensure job sites are stocked with required installation supplies.
* Assist with receiving and overseeing cabinet deliveries.
* Deliver parts and supplies to job sites when required.
* Maintain assigned vehicles according to internal procedures.

**Customer Service \& Scheduling**

* Schedule homeowner and warranty issues when required.
* Support multiple project schedules, budgets, and quality objectives.

**Teamwork \& Professionalism**

* Demonstrate strong work ethic, reliable communication, and team\-oriented behavior.
* Complete additional project\-related tasks as assigned.

**Education \& Certifications**

· Some secondary school education is usually required, post\-secondary considered an asset

**Experience**

· Minimum two years of multi\-unit cabinetry and millwork installation experience

· Proven ability to track work in a meticulous fashion

**Skills \& Competencies**

· Multi\-unit cabinetry and millwork installation experience preferred

· Valid BC Driver’s license preferred where driving for business is a requirement

· Working with hand tools

· Working with full suite of MS Office and Smartsheets

· Excellent in communication, teamwork, problem‑solving

**Compliance \& Training Requirements**

· BC Driver’s License if required for position

· WHMIS

· Anti‑Violence / Respectful Workplace

· Valid Work Permit (if applicable)

· English language skills appropriate to the role

· Adherence to WorkSafeBC requirements, including recover‑at‑work practices

· Adherence to internal manuals and standard operating procedures

· Steel\-toed footwear

**Working Conditions**

Each job site has varied conditions. Finishing trades work in units with doors and windows (insulated) but may not be complete to finish level including electrical, floors, fixtures and fittings and paint. The work is mostly conducted during site hours, which may vary within each job location. Occasional weekend work and travel may be required.

**Physical Requirements**

Project and site technicians are occasionally asked to assist in the movement of product around site. The criteria for lifting is up to 50lbs before it becomes a two\-person lift (noting, this work should be designed to casual labor, anything that is done by the Project Manager should be the exception, not the rule). Installers are generally required to climb stairs on a frequent basis when elevators are not available in buildings and must be. Installers are required to kneel, bend, and crouch to install various cabinet types.

It is incumbent on the site staff to take micro breaks every two hours as mandated by internal policy.

Due to the operational requirements of the job, physician’s note of physical capability may be requested at any time.

Pay: $27\.00\-$32\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Company events

Work Location: In person
