We are seeking a skilled Network Administrator who loves the satisfaction of directly helping people, solving technical puzzles, and tackling everything from quick user calls to complex infrastructure issues.

In this role, you won’t be buried behind project plans all day—you will be our go\-to expert for user support, bringing senior\-level expertise to our service desk while managing core network, active directory, and cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

* **Front\-Line Escalation \& Support:** Serve as a primary point of contact for clients via phone, email, chat, and ticketing system, delivering fast, patient, and expert resolution to everyday end\-user requests as well as escalated technical issues.
* **Server \& Directory Administration:** Manage, maintain, and troubleshoot Active Directory (GPOs, user lifecycle, security groups, schema), Windows Server environments, and hybrid identity structures.
* **Network Operations:** Install, configure, and troubleshoot enterprise networking equipment, including switches, firewalls, routers, Wi\-Fi access points, and site\-to\-site/client VPNs.
* **Microsoft 365 Management:** Administer M365 environments (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Azure AD/Entra ID, Security \& Compliance) and resolve advanced tenant and synchronization issues.
* **Full\-Spectrum Troubleshooting:** Provide comprehensive Tier 1 through Tier 3 support across desktops (Windows/macOS), mobile devices, line\-of\-business applications, and infrastructure hardware.
* **Ticket Management \& PSA:** Log, update, prioritize, and resolve service tickets within our PSA system (ConnectWise preferred) with high accuracy and attention to detail.
* **Documentation \& KB Creation:** Maintain precise system documentation, network diagrams, and standard operating procedures to empower both clients and internal team members.
* **Escalation \& Collaboration:** Take ownership of complex issues, route specialized project work to senior engineers when necessary, and maintain awareness of client infrastructure changes.
* **On\-Call Support:** Participate in a scheduled on\-call rotation to support critical client needs outside standard business hours.

Qualifications \& SkillsRequired:

* **1\+ years of experience** in systems/network administration and technical support (preferably within a Managed Services Provider / MSP environment).
* **Deep Networking Knowledge:** Strong proficiency with TCP/IP, Subnetting, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Routing protocols, Firewalls, and VPN configuration.
* **Active Directory \& Server Expertise:** Hands\-on experience with Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy, and hybrid Azure AD environments.
* **Microsoft 365 Administration:** Comprehensive understanding of M365 administration, mail flow, permissions, and cloud identity management.
* **Service\-First Mindset:** A genuine passion for customer service, empathetic communication, and guiding users through technical issues with clarity and patience.
* **Diagnostic Instincts:** Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose root causes across network, hardware, and software layers under pressure.

Preferred:

* **Certifications:** CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator / Enterprise Administrator.
* **PSA \& RMM Tools:** Familiarity with ConnectWise Manage (or Autotask) and modern Remote Monitoring \& Management tools.
* **Security \& Backup:** Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, endpoint protection, and backup/disaster recovery solutions.

* Paid time off

jobs.title: Advisor, Technical Support L1
jobs.description:
**Description de l'entreprise**  

For over 40 years, LGI has built software that healthcare organizations depend on. AI is now at the heart of that work — not as a destination, but as the engine behind our next generation of mission\-critical solutions and our enduring mission: helping healthcare organizations perform at their best.


We're looking for exceptional people who are passionate about technology, relentless in their standards, and driven to push what's possible further. At LGI, curiosity isn't a nice\-to\-have, it's how we work. We're looking for talent who explore and innovate by instinct and want their work to matter beyond the codebase: shaping decisions, enhancing processes, and enabling healthcare practitioners.

 **Description du poste**  

Are you looking to advance your career by joining a team of passionate and motivated professionals who bring their talents to the healthcare system?


Dare to take the leap and realize your full potential with us in an inspiring and dynamic environment that values flexibility, teamwork, learning, and excellence.

**What will your days be like at LGI Healthcare Solutions?**


In this position, you will be the main point of contact between the company and its customers. Your mission will be to ensure a smooth and positive customer experience, by providing quality technical support and delivering solutions tailored to users' needs. Clear communication, empathy, and proactive problem\-solving will be at the heart of your responsibilities.

**How will your contributions be showcased?**

* Ensure effective and empathetic communication with customers by phone or e\-mail, quickly identifying their needs and offering appropriate solutions.
* Guide customers step\-by\-step in solving technical problems, using language understandable to a non\-technical audience.
* Offer personalized follow\-up and ensure that customers are kept informed throughout the process of resolving their incidents.
* Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions, ensuring that the history is well traced for optimal follow\-up.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to specialized technical teams while maintaining open communication with the customer.
* Participate in ongoing training to reinforce your communication skills and technical knowledge, in order to constantly improve customer satisfaction.
* Provide recommendations on best practices in the use of products and services.

 **Qualifications** **What you will bring to LGI Healthcare Solutions to succeed in this role:**

* A degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
* One to three years of experience in a technical support role with a strong customer\-facing component.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for a non\-technical audience.
* Experience using artificial intelligence—for example, for case analysis or agent creation—would be considered a significant asset. Alternatively, candidates must demonstrate a strong curiosity and commitment to learning and developing their ability to use AI in their work.
* Excellent knowledge of Windows environments is required. Additional knowledge of and/or professional experience with Linux or Solaris environments would be considered a significant asset.
* Experience providing technical support for business intelligence (BI) applications would be considered a significant asset.
* Strong active\-listening skills to fully understand customers’ issues and anticipate their needs.
* Empathy and patience in understanding customers’ frustrations and helping them overcome technical challenges.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage tense situations professionally and courteously.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues while communicating solutions in clear and accessible language.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work with other departments to improve the solutions provided to customers.
* This position requires excellent French\-language communication skills, as the successful candidate will work with French\-language documentation and communicate verbally and in writing with French\-speaking partners, customers, suppliers, and colleagues. A good command of English would be considered an asset.

  

**Informations complémentaires** **Why join LGI?**

* A workplace built on trust, autonomy and collaboration
* The opportunity to grow, perform and work alongside curious and talented colleagues
* A continuous learning culture with dedicated training time, a renowed skills development platform and access to cutting\-edge tools
* Stimulating projects that advance healthcare technology and support the work of over 320,000 professionals, benefiting more than 6 million patients
* A comprehensive benefits package including group insurance from day one, a group RRSP with employer contributions, 24/7 telemedicine, an employee and family assistance program, and a minimum of 3 weeks vacation per year


At LGI Healthcare Solutions, we value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe that a diversity of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds contributes to our success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and respectful work environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply.

**Interested? Join Us!**

jobs.title: Level 2 IT Support & Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Level 2 IT Support \& Systems Administrator


**Premiere Suites**

**Position Overview**

Premiere Suites is seeking a Level 2 IT Support \& Systems Administrator to provide day\-to\-day technical support and administration across our corporate technology environment.


This role serves as a primary point of contact for employee technology support and is responsible for maintaining user accounts, devices, Microsoft 365 services, access permissions, and a range of business applications. The successful candidate will combine strong customer service and troubleshooting skills with hands\-on systems administration experience and an ability to work independently in a multi\-system environment.


The position will also support the administration and ongoing improvement of key business platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk, SharePoint, Telus Business Connect, and other corporate applications.


**Key Responsibilities**

*End\-User Support \& Service Management*

* Provide primary triage, troubleshooting, and resolution of employee IT support requests and tickets.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, Microsoft 365, application, connectivity, printer, and peripheral issues.
* Provide remote technical support to employees across multiple locations.
* Set up, configure, deploy, and reconfigure laptops and other end\-user devices.
* Install and configure approved software, applications, plugins, and services.
* Escalate complex infrastructure, security, application, or integration issues when appropriate.
* Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, configurations, and recurring issues.
* Provide technical guidance to employees and help users effectively use company technology.

*Microsoft 365 \& Entra ID Administration*

* Create, modify, disable, and manage employee user accounts.
* Manage passwords, account access, security groups, permissions, and user lifecycle activities.
* Assign and modify Microsoft licensing based on approved requirements.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID administration, including user access and permissions.
* Assist with monitoring authentication and account\-related security alerts and potentially compromised accounts.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications and services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
* Administer SharePoint access groups, permissions, and user access.
* Assist with Exchange Online administration, including mailbox access, mail flow troubleshooting, and related user issues.

*Device \& Endpoint Administration*

* Monitor and maintain end\-user devices to ensure they remain secure, patched, and operational.
* Ensure operating systems, antivirus/security tools, and approved applications remain current.
* Monitor device health, hardware condition, storage capacity, and performance.
* Use remote management tools to troubleshoot devices and deploy software or updates.
* Support device onboarding, replacement, reassignment, and offboarding processes.
* Maintain accurate records of company devices, configurations, and assignments.

*Business Systems Administration \& Support*

Provide day\-to\-day administration, user support, access management, and troubleshooting for Premiere Suites' business technology platforms, including Salesforce, Zendesk, SharePoint, Telus Business Connect, Adobe, DocuSign, QuickBooks Online, PayPal, GoDaddy, Cloudflare, Twilio, and other business applications adopted by the organization.


* Create and modify users and permissions.
* Troubleshoot user and configuration issues.
* Support application configuration and routine administrative changes.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors when issues require escalation.
* Maintain documentation related to application configuration, access, and support procedures.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve system usability and support processes.

*Salesforce \& Business Application Support*

* Provide user administration and day\-to\-day support for Salesforce.
* Manage users, access, permissions, and routine configuration requests.
* Troubleshoot user issues and coordinate escalation of more complex Salesforce problems.
* Support Salesforce adoption by assisting employees with system questions and directing users to appropriate training resources.
* Assist with testing and validation of configuration changes, integrations, and system enhancements.
* Support related platforms and integrations such as Zendesk, Telus Business Connect, and other approved sales technology solutions.
* Work with business stakeholders to understand system issues and identify opportunities for improvement.

*Security \& Access Management*

* Follow established security policies and access\-management procedures.
* Assist with monitoring Microsoft Entra security alerts, risky sign\-ins, compromised accounts, and other user\-level security events.
* Support multi\-factor authentication and conditional access requirements.
* Ensure access is appropriately provisioned and removed during employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding.
* Escalate security incidents or suspicious activity in accordance with company procedures.
* Support periodic access and permissions reviews.

*Network, Office \& Peripheral Support*

* Troubleshoot basic office network and connectivity issues.
* Support printers, network\-connected devices, meeting\-room technology, and other office equipment.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of network appliances and connectivity issues before escalation.
* Coordinate with vendors or senior technical resources when infrastructure\-level intervention is required.

*Documentation \& Continuous Improvement*

* Maintain current technical documentation, support procedures, system inventories, and configuration information.
* Document common issues and resolutions to improve internal knowledge and employee self\-service.
* Identify repetitive support activities that could be standardized or improved.
* Participate in testing

jobs.title: Technicien TI
jobs.description:
**BPA, c’est bien plus qu’une firme d’ingénierie :** c’est une équipe passionnée qui façonne les bâtiments et infrastructures de demain. Présente à travers le Canada, notre expertise en conception durable et en innovation technique fait rayonner nos projets d’un océan à l’autre. Joindre BPA, c’est mettre ton talent au service d’un impact concret, collaborer avec des experts reconnus et évoluer dans un milieu flexible, stimulant et tourné vers l’avenir.
  
  

Vous êtes passionné par la technologie et par le service à la clientèle?
  
Joignez\-vous à notre équipe TI dynamique et jouez un rôle clé en soutenant le bureau de Montréal sur place, tout en contribuant à des initiatives nationales qui assurent le bon fonctionnement et la connectivité de toute notre organisation.
  
Vos responsabilités
  
* Offrir un support en présentiel dans nos trois bureaux de la région de Montréal, en répondant aux incidents et aux demandes de service avec une approche orientée client.
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques, et escalader au besoin pour minimiser les interruptions.
* Documenter les systèmes et procédures TI, ainsi que toutes les étapes et solutions apportées, dans notre système de billetterie.
* Effectuer la maintenance préventive des systèmes, serveurs et équipements connectés au réseau.
* Participer à des projets majeurs de déploiement de systèmes et de solutions TI à l’échelle nationale.
* Collaborer à l’amélioration des processus et à l’optimisation des systèmes afin de rehausser l’expérience utilisateur.
* Gérer l’inventaire et contribuer au cycle de renouvellement des équipements.


Votre profil
  
* Diplôme professionnel ou technique en administration des TI, réseautique ou tout autre domaine connexe.
* 2\-5 années d’expérience dans un rôle similaire.
* Bilingue français\-anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, afin de soutenir l’ensemble de nos bureaux à travers le Canada.\*
* Maîtrise de Microsoft Office 365, Active Directory, VMWare et des systèmes de billetterie.
* Capacité d’adaptation, flexibilité et volonté d’améliorer continuellement les processus.
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en résolution de problèmes, avec un fort esprit d’équipe.
* Sens marqué du service à la clientèle – vous aimez aider les gens et offrir une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle.
* La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise afin de soutenir nos activités à l’échelle canadienne et notre collaboration avec nos équipes et clients dans les autres provinces.


Pourquoi vous joindre à nous ?
  
* Un rôle avec un impact local et une portée nationale – soutien en personne pour la région de Québec et collaboration avec des collègues partout au pays.
* Un environnement collaboratif où vos idées sont écoutées.
* Des opportunités de développement professionnel et d’avancement en TI et en support client.
* Une organisation innovante et en pleine croissance qui investit dans ses talents et ses technologies.


Si vous souhaitez mettre à profit vos compétences techniques tout en offrant un service client hors pair, nous aimerions vous rencontrer !
  
  

Faire carrière avec nous, c’est…
  
* Une culture centrée sur la collaboration, axée sur le partage du savoir, le développement des talents et la qualité de nos réalisations.
* Une semaine de 37,5 heures, avec un horaire flexible et la possibilité de terminer à midi le vendredi.
* Une politique de télétravail hybride, favorisant la conciliation entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
* Les heures supplémentaires reconnues et compensées, soit en banque d’heures, soit rémunérées.
* Une rémunération globale compétitive, comprenant un salaire concurrentiel, un régime d’assurances complet et un programme de REER avec contribution de l’employeur.
* Un programme structuré de formation et de développement professionnel, soutenu par notre entité UniversiT, dédiée à la croissance technique et humaine de chaque employé.
* Un programme de mentorat sur mesure, adapté selon les niveaux d’expérience et les parcours professionnels.
* Des technologies à la fine pointe, dont le BIM et des outils collaboratifs modernes.
* Un programme « En quête d’équilibre », qui vise à favoriser le bien\-être global, la santé mentale et la productivité durable.


Nous adhérons aux principes d’équité en matière d’emploi, de diversité, d’inclusion et d’accessibilité dans l’ensemble de nos bureaux au Canada. Nous encourageons les candidatures de femmes, de personnes issues de minorités visibles, de peuples autochtones, de personnes en situation de handicap ainsi que de membres de la communauté 2SLGBTQIA\+.Des mesures d’adaptation sont offertes sur demande aux candidats participant à toute étape du processus de sélection.
  
Nous vous remercions de votre intérêt à joindre notre équipe. Veuillez noter que seules les personnes sélectionnées pour une entrevue seront contactées par l’équipe Talent.

Poste régulier.

L’Université TÉLUQ souscrit aux programmes d’accès à l’égalité et l’équité en matière d’emploi et valorise la diversité et l’inclusion au sein de sa communauté. Rejoignez\-nous et concentrons\-nous ensemble sur ce qui est vraiment important : améliorer la vie grâce à de nouvelles idées et aux dernières technologies à travers le monde.

**Pourquoi vous allez adorer travailler chez Siemens !**

* Liberté et équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée : profitez de notre environnement de travail flexible avec des horaires flexibles, le télétravail et des espaces de travail numériques.
* Résolvez les problèmes les plus importants au monde : participez à des projets passionnants et innovants.

* Droit à des congés gratifiants avec la possibilité d'acheter et de vendre vos congés en fonction de votre mode de vie.

**Que ferez\-vous ?**


En tant que membre clé de l'équipe Performance et assistance technique, vous contribuerez à la réalisation des objectifs de notre contrat d'assistance technique et de fourniture de pièces de rechange (TSSSA). Votre rôle est essentiel pour garantir des performances élevées en matière de sécurité, de fiabilité opérationnelle et de satisfaction client, mesurées en termes de coût, de qualité et d'expérience client globale. Vous fournirez une assistance technique mécanique au personnel des gares, au personnel de bord et au personnel de maintenance de nos clients afin d'améliorer la fiabilité des équipements de la flotte de locomotives et de voitures Siemens. Vous fournirez des conseils sur la maintenance courante et corrective, la résolution et l'atténuation des pannes d'équipement et le sauvetage des trains. Vous développerez des relations solides et fructueuses avec le client. Vous assisterez le service clientèle de Siemens Mobilité en fournissant des détails sur les demandes des clients concernant le département mécanique. Vous favoriserez l'augmentation de la productivité et de la qualité grâce à un solide savoir\-faire, à votre expérience, à une collaboration fructueuse et à une réflexion innovante.

* Préparer et participer aux passations de service/briefings/transmissions avec le conseiller technique.
* Préparer toutes les informations nécessaires pour les réunions quotidiennes/hebdomadaires avec le client, telles que les rapports, les téléchargements, les données de surveillance de la flotte, les relevés, etc.
* Soutenir les enquêtes sur les pannes et la réalisation des rapports d'analyse des causes profondes en servant de ressource pour collecter et distribuer les données relatives aux pannes et aux incidents aux utilisateurs finaux, en utilisant une application PowerApps pour normaliser la production des rapports d'incidents.
* Soutenir les efforts visant à améliorer la fiabilité et à assurer une amélioration continue afin de minimiser les temps d'arrêt et les coûts.
* Servir de ressource pour accéder aux données du système de gestion de maintenance assistée par ordinateur (CMMS) du client et distribuer les données de manière programmée et ponctuelle.
* Assurer une communication adéquate entre le client et l'équipe des services sur le terrain.
* Fournir des commentaires à l'équipe concernant les questions de performance, de qualité et de productivité.
* Développer une relation de travail avec le client en tant qu'employé et représentant de Siemens Mobilité.

**Connaissances, compétences, formation et expérience requises :**

* Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec d'excellentes compétences en communication dans les deux langues.
* Diplôme en électricité ou en mécanique ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.
* Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans un environnement industriel, de maintenance ou de mise en service, de préférence dans le secteur du matériel roulant ou ferroviaire.
* Une expérience dans le domaine du support technique à distance ou du service à la clientèle sera considérée comme un atout.

* Capacité à travailler de manière autono

jobs.title: Technicien support et formation utilisateurs
jobs.description:
TEHORA est présentement à la recherche d’**un Technicien support et formation utilisateurs** afin d’assurer le soutien opérationnel et l’accompagnement des utilisateurs .


Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue :

* Répondre aux demandes de soutien technique et fonctionnel;
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents utilisateurs;
* Assurer le suivi des billets de service;
* Produire les guides d’utilisation et la documentation de soutien;
* Concevoir et mettre à jour les vidéos de formation en français;
* Animer des séances de formation à distance;
* Participer aux activités de déploiement et d’accompagnement du changement

  

**Requirements**  

* Détenir une formation collégiale ou universitaire pertinente;
* Posséder une expérience en soutien technique ou en formation;
* Maîtriser les outils Microsoft 365;
* Posséder d’excellentes aptitudes en communication et en vulgarisation;
* Faire preuve de professionnalisme et d’autonomie;
* Posséder une excellente maîtrise du français parlé et écrit.

 **Benefits**  

* Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales
* Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l’innovation
* Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)
* Congés en cas de maladie et à l’occasion d’événements familiaux
* Outils informatiques adaptés
* Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant
* Initiatives sociales et environnementales
* Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail
* Cheminement de carrière


SALAIRE
Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.


LIEU DE TRAVAIL
Montréal\- Hybride


POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA ?
TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir\-faire et de notre créativité.


Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connaît une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.


Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.


TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.


Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.


Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

jobs.description:
Support Delivery \- Ontario \- Remote

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post\-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. We’re looking for dedicated, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale.


Beyond resolving technical issues how support operates at scale.


**Note: each person in this role will be expected to work a standard 5x8 work week, with 1 of the days covering weekend shifts each week (e.g., work weeks covering Tuesday \- Saturday or Sunday \- Thursday)**

* Working directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents. * Becoming a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and platform, serving as a go\-to resource for complex technical issues.

* Taking learnings from resolving customer issues and creating our approach to scaling these solutions, partnering with Product and Go\-To\-Market teams.
* Driving operational excellence by identifying opportunities for automation and AI\-powered workflows, implementing scalable improvements that increase team efficiency, reducing manual effort, and elevating the overall support experience.
* Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**


* Have 8\+ years of experience in User Operations, Engineering, Support Engineering or similar technical roles, ideally within high\-growth tech startups or other fast\-paced environments.
* Are comfortable using emerging technologies (ie. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) to script or engineer code (e.g., Python) for automating repetitive tasks and integrating tools.
* Have expert\-level SaaS troubleshooting skills with the ability to rapidly understand new technologies and complex concepts.
* Polished enterprise communication and are calm with high\-stakes customers during live incident calls
* Proven experience building strong relationships with customers and cross\-functional partners to drive resolution to complex issues.
* Exceptional critical thinker and problem solver with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to both customers and internal teams.
* Thrive in ambiguity, adapt rapidly to change, continuously learn, and proactively seek opportunities for growth.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Level 1 Help Desk Support Technician - Calgary
jobs.description:
CloudOrbis is a growing Managed IT Services Provider (MSP) with operations supporting businesses across Alberta and Ontario. We deliver managed IT, Microsoft 365, Azure, cybersecurity, networking, cloud, and consulting services to organizations in a wide range of industries.

At CloudOrbis, we pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service, proactive technology management, and trusted IT guidance to our clients. We are looking for a driven and customer\-focused **Level 1 Help Desk Support Technician** who is passionate about technology and eager to grow their career in the IT industry.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across a wide variety of technologies, industries, and client environments while working alongside experienced IT professionals.

**Position Overview**

As a Level 1 Help Desk Support Technician, you will be the first point of contact for client support requests. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, assist with workstation deployments, support Microsoft 365 environments, and provide both remote and onsite support to clients.

This is an **on\-site position based out of our Calgary, Alberta office**, with regular travel to client locations using a company vehicle.

Key Responsibilities

* Respond to support requests via phone, email, remote support tools, and ticketing systems.
* Troubleshoot Windows desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and business applications.
* Support Microsoft 365 services including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange Online.
* Create and manage user accounts, licenses, permissions, and groups in Microsoft 365 and Active Directory.
* Assist with new user onboarding and employee offboarding.
* Deploy and configure computers, laptops, software, and mobile devices.
* Troubleshoot basic networking issues including Wi\-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, DNS, and DHCP.
* Perform routine maintenance, updates, and system checks.
* Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions accurately within ticketing and documentation systems.
* Escalate complex issues to senior technicians as required.
* Participate in client onboarding projects, technology assessments, migrations, and hardware deployments.
* Provide onsite support at client offices throughout the Edmonton Metropolitan Region and surrounding communities.
* Maintain a professional and positive client experience during all interactions.
* Utilize AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and other modern productivity tools to improve troubleshooting, research, documentation, and overall efficiency.
* Participate in an after\-hours on\-call rotation to support urgent client issues when scheduled.

**Qualifications**

Required

* Diploma, degree, or certification in Information Technology, Computer Systems Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Strong knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11\.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications and services.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts including:
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* VPN
* Wireless Networking
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Professional, dependable, and customer\-focused attitude.
* Comfortable leveraging AI\-powered tools to improve productivity and service delivery.

**Driving Requirements**

This role includes regular travel to client locations using a company vehicle.

Applicants must:

* Hold a valid Alberta Class 5 driver's license.
* Have a clean driving record.
* Be insurable under the company's vehicle insurance policy.
* Be comfortable driving throughout Calgary and surrounding Alberta communities.
* Represent CloudOrbis professionally while onsite at client locations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The following qualifications are considered strong assets:

* Previous experience working for a Managed Services Provider (MSP).
* Experience supporting multiple clients and environments simultaneously.
* Experience with:
* Microsoft Intune
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Microsoft Azure
* Active Directory
* Windows Server
* Microsoft Defender
* Remote Monitoring \& Management (RMM) platforms
* Professional Services Automation (PSA) platforms
* Familiarity with HaloPSA, NinjaOne, Huntress, ConnectWise, Datto RMM, or similar tools.
* Microsoft certifications such as:
* MS\-900
* AZ\-900
* CompTIA certifications such as:
* A\+
* Network\+
* Security\+
* Experience using AI tools professionally to enhance troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and operational efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate:

* Has a passion for technology and helping people.
* Enjoys troubleshooting and solving technical problems.
* Is curious, motivated, and eager to learn.
* Takes ownership of tasks and follows issues through to resolution.
* Communicates professionally with both technical and non\-technical users.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced MSP environment.
* Is organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
* Uses AI and modern technology tools to work smarter and more efficiently.
* Is reliable and willing to participate in an on\-call support rotation.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Company vehicle for client visits.
* Exposure to a broad range of technologies and business environments.
* Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
* Support for industry certifications and career growth.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Opportunity to work with Microsoft cloud technologies, cybersecurity solutions, and emerging AI tools.

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent

**Location:** Calgary, Alberta

**Work Arrangement:** On\-Site

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, plus participation in an after\-hours on\-call rotation.

Pay: $40,000\.00\-$45,000\.00 per year

**Job Title:** Level 2 IT Desktop Support Technician  
**Company:** Precision IT

**Company Overview**  
Precision IT is a dynamic IT services provider dedicated to delivering exceptional managed IT solutions to our clients. We are seeking a motivated Level 2 Desktop Support Technician with a minimum of 2 years of working experience in an IT MSP environment, to join our team and ensure our clients achieve optimal productivity through reliable technical support.

**Job Summary**

**Location:** In\-Office (on\-site)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent

**Salary Range:** $55,000 \- $60,000 CAD per year

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PCT (overtime or after\-hours work may be required based on client needs, tickets, or projects)

The Level 2 Desktop Support Technician will provide advanced technical support for hardware, software, networking, and infrastructure\-related issues to our managed clients, ensuring exceptional service and efficient problem resolution. This role is ideal for someone passionate about technology, experienced in MSP environments, and eager to grow in the IT field.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Respond to inbound phone inquiries and provide exceptional customer service to clients.
* Prioritize and manage support tickets based on severity and business impact.
* Diagnose, analyze, and troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues using critical thinking skills.
* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding processes, including provisioning accounts, setting up hardware, and configuring application access.

jobs.title: Field Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**  

As a Field Support Engineer, you will make an impact by providing onsite and remote support for end\-user devices, Microsoft 365 applications, and workplace technology services. You will support incident resolution, endpoint lifecycle management, and field service activities while ensuring a high\-quality user experience and adherence to service level agreements. You will be a valued member of the Cloud Infrastructure and Security team, working collaboratively with infrastructure, operations, and service management teams.

**In this role, you will**

* Provide onsite and remote support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, docking stations, and peripherals.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity issues.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and Office Suite.
* Assist users with VPN, Wi\-Fi, MFA, and access\-related issues.
* Respond to incidents and service requests within agreed SLA timelines.
* Perform ticket triage, diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution activities.
* Escalate unresolved issues to specialized support teams with complete troubleshooting details.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation and user communication throughout the ticket lifecycle.
* Provide deskside support requiring physical intervention at office locations.
* Coordinate asset replacements, hardware repairs, warranty claims, and vendor visits.
* Support workstation deployments, office relocations, conference room technologies, and site\-specific IT activities.
* Act as a customer\-facing point of contact for onsite technical support.
* Perform device imaging, deployment, refresh, and decommissioning activities.
* Install, configure, and upgrade operating systems and applications.
* Maintain asset inventory and CMDB accuracy.
* Support laptop provisioning and endpoint deployment activities.

**Work model**  

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Toronto, ON.

*The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.*

**What you need to have to be considered**

* 5\+ years of experience providing desktop, deskside, or field services support in an enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting Windows operating systems, desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.
* Hands\-on experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and Office Suite.
* Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, networking, and end\-user access issues.
* Experience working with ticketing systems in an SLA\-driven support environment.
* Knowledge of VPN, Wi\-Fi, MFA, and identity/access support.
* Experience with device imaging, deployment, refresh, and endpoint lifecycle management.
* Strong customer service, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

**These will help you stand out**

* Experience supporting executive users and customer\-facing environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management best practices.
* Experience with conference room and collaboration technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, or endpoint management solutions.
* Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA, or end\-user computing certifications.


We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

**Total compensation**  

We regularly assess market data to ensure we offer a competitive compensation package for our associates. The base salary for this position ranges between $77,500\.00 – 90,000\.00 per year. Where the successful candidate may fall within the range depends on relevant education, work and/or management experience and other business\-related and job\-necessary qualifications. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual performance\-based bonus, as well as benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing.

jobs.title: NOC Tier 1 Technician
jobs.description:
**Job Posting**

 **Tier 1 NOC Technician**

 **Who We Are**


We are a fast\-growing and forward\-thinking company that owns, manages and operates extensive fibre\-optic networks, and has been offering the ultimate in connectivity since 2014\. Focused on expanding coverage in regions of central and western Canada, we’re bringing more choice and better service to businesses and the people who live there.

  

Everyone at FlexNetworks is committed to customer loyalty and to earn and retain our customer’s trust by delivering exceptional service and exceeding expectations. We are a communicative and collaborative team who work together towards our shared goals. FlexNetworks puts People First. We do this by fostering an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive!




The Tier 1 Network Operations Centre (NOC) Technician is responsible for the aggregation of trouble tickets across the disparate ticketing systems and outsourced, third\-party NOC entities that are engaged for FlexNetworks’ Business, Residential, and MDU lines of business. This role provides daily operational oversight to perform trouble ticket triage and resolution, ticket escalation, timely customer and internal communications, while ensuring strict adherence to SLA objectives.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **NOC Governance \& Quality Oversight**

  

* Perform triage between Network, Field Operations, and Customer Experience.
* Conduct reviews of all tickets handled to verify runbook compliance, SLA adherence, escalation completion, and communication quality.
* Monitor open tickets throughout the day for overdue updates, escalation needs, and documentation of next steps.
* Define and communicate areas where the NOCs can improve upon on ticket quality, classification accuracy, and communication standards.
* Ensure ticket queues maintain clarity, accuracy, and completeness of customer and technical information.

 **Ticket Ownership \& Assignment Integrity**

  

* Review and ensure assignment of all unassigned or misrouted tickets across all customer segments (Business, Residential, MDU).
* Validate that each ticket has a clear owner, correct severity category, and documented next action.
* Coordinate with the and Call Centre to ensure they have the information, context, and guidance needed to independently assess whether an issue is network\-related or requires field operations.

This is an entry\-level role designed for someone with an electronics, electrical, or mechanical trade background who is ready to learn the specialized world of weigh scale technology. Working alongside experienced technicians, you will learn to install, service, troubleshoot, and calibrate weighing equipment used across the Maritimes. Through a structured 12\-week onboarding program you will work toward your first Measurement Canada accreditation, then continue building your skills and earning additional accreditations (with pay increases tied to each) over your first one to three years. **This is a permanent, full\-time position reporting to the Operations Manager.**

* Service, troubleshoot, and repair weighing equipment (load cells, indicators, junction boxes, and associated wiring), diagnosing both electrical and mechanical faults
* Prepare scales for Measurement Canada inspection and accurately complete calibration certificates, test weight correlation forms, and product test sheets
* Achieve Measurement Canada accreditation for bench and floor scales (MC 3\-10\) within the first three months
* Shadow and assist senior technicians on truck scale, industrial, and systems service calls and installation projects

jobs.title: Network Field Technician
jobs.description:
Network Field Technician

**Viverlink Networks Inc. \| British Columbia**  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Setting:** On\-site / Field\-based  
**Location:** Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.  
**Travel:** Regular travel between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.; occasional travel to other areas of Ontario may be required.

About Viverlink Networks

Viverlink Networks Inc. is a growing Managed Field Services Provider (MFSP) supporting MSPs, technology companies, enterprise IT teams, and multi\-location organizations.

We provide reliable onsite IT and infrastructure execution, acting as the field\-service execution layer between remote IT operations and physical customer locations.

Our services include:

* On\-site IT and technical support
* Network and connectivity installations
* Infrastructure deployments and technology rollouts
* Hardware and workstation deployments
* Structured cabling and physical network infrastructure
* Security and compliance\-related installations

Our work is performed using defined work orders, professional field procedures, structured documentation, and clear communication with remote IT teams and project managers.

As Viverlink expands its regional presence in the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC., we are building a professional field\-service network and are looking for technicians who can grow with the organization and take on increasingly complex assignments.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Network Field Technician** who is comfortable working independently at customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC. and can represent Viverlink professionally in the field.

This is a hands\-on role involving network equipment installation, troubleshooting, structured cabling, hardware deployment, and onsite technical support.

You will frequently work from detailed work orders and coordinate with remote engineers, MSP teams, project managers, and customer representatives.

The right candidate does not need to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting instincts, professional communication, and the ability to learn and grow.

Key ResponsibilitiesNetwork \& Infrastructure

* Install, replace, configure, and test network equipment such as switches, routers, wireless access points, and related hardware.
* Perform basic network connectivity troubleshooting using TCP/IP concepts and common diagnostic methods.
* Identify and troubleshoot physical network and infrastructure issues.
* Perform structured cabling activities, including cable routing, termination, labeling, patching, and basic testing.
* Install and organize network equipment in racks, cabinets, and customer environments.
* Assist with network upgrades, technology rollouts, hardware refreshes, and multi\-site deployments.
* Perform hardware replacement and equipment installation according to approved work instructions.

Field Service Execution

* Review work orders and site requirements before arriving onsite.
* Arrive prepared with the required tools, information, and equipment.
* Follow client\-specific instructions, technical documentation, site procedures, and safety requirements.
* Work independently while maintaining communication with remote technical teams.
* Escalate issues when they exceed the assigned scope or technical authority.
* Avoid making unauthorized changes to customer environments.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate work\-order and ticket information.
* Document work performed, findings, configuration changes, serial numbers, and relevant observations.
* Capture required photographs and other completion evidence.
* Clearly communicate issues, blockers, and outstanding work.
* Complete professional field\-service reports following Viverlink and client requirements.

Customer Interaction

* Represent Viverlink professionally at customer locations.
* Communicate clearly with site contacts and customer personnel.
* Manage expectations and provide accurate status updates.
* Maintain a professional presence in offices, retail locations, technical facilities, and other customer environments.
* Protect customer information and follow applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

Required Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate practical ability in several of the following areas:

Networking

* Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking.
* Familiarity with switches, routers, wireless access points, and network cabling.
* Ability to perform basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand IP addressing, Ethernet, VLAN concepts, and common network terminology.

Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure

* Experience with structured cabling.
* Ability to terminate, label, organize, and test network cables.
* Familiarity with patch panels, racks, cable management, and physical network infrastructure.
* Ability to use basic field testing and hand tools.

Troubleshooting

* Ability to systematically identify the cause of technical problems.
* Comfortable troubleshooting connectivity, hardware, cabling, and physical infrastructure issues.
* Able to distinguish between issues that can be resolved onsite and those requiring escalation.

Field Service

* Comfortable working independently at customer sites.
* Able to follow work orders and technical instructions accurately.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Reliable and punctual.
* Comfortable travelling between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.

Communication

* Professional verbal and written communication.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical personnel.
* Able to provide concise and accurate field updates.

Assets / Preferred Qualifications

The following are considered assets but are **not mandatory**:

* CompTIA Network\+
*

jobs.title: Analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes
jobs.description:
**Lieu**
--------



Ottawa (Ontario)


**Rémunération prévue**
-----------------------



50 000 $ – 65 000 $


**Supérieur immédiat**
----------------------



Directeur, technologies de l’information et sécurité informatique


**Résumé**
----------



Le Parti libéral du Canada (PLC) est à la recherche d’un analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes pour travailler à la permanence nationale du parti à Ottawa. Il s’agit d’une occasion de se joindre à une équipe d’employés dévoués qui appuient Mark Carney et l’équipe libérale pour continuer de bâtir un Canada fort.



L’analyste, soutien informatique et systèmes est chargé de fournir un soutien technique aux employés et aux bénévoles partout au pays tout en contribuant à assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et l’efficacité de l’infrastructure de TI du parti.



Le candidat idéal est soucieux du service client, à l’écoute des autres et compétent sur le plan technique. Il s’épanouit dans un milieu collaboratif au rythme soutenu.


**Avantages offerts**
---------------------


* Couverture d’assurance complète
* Programmes de bien\-être
* Programme d’aide aux employés et à leur famille
* Régime de retraite à cotisations déterminées
* Horaire de travail flexible
* Emplacement de choix au centre\-ville, à proximité des commerces et des transports en commun
* Adhésion sans frais à un centre de conditionnement physique et accès à des douches
* Casiers pour vélos

**Qualités recherchées**
------------------------


* Communication
* Capacité à résoudre des problèmes
* Bonne gestion du temps
* Responsabilisation
* Souci du détail
* Professionnalisme

**Responsabilités**
-------------------


* Fournir un soutien en TI de premier niveau aux employés qui travaillent partout au pays.
* Faciliter l’intégration et le départ des employés et des intervenants, notamment en termes de création de comptes, de mise en place de l’équipement et de gestion des accès.
* Déployer et maintenir les mises à jour du système d’exploitation et des applications pour veiller à ce que les systèmes demeurent sécurisés et bénéficient d’un soutien technique.
* Surveiller et maintenir l’infrastructure et les services d’infonuagique.
* Participer aux activités liées à la cybersécurité, notamment aux niveaux de la gestion des vulnérabilités, du programme de sensibilisation à la sécurité et de l’application des pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité.
* Créer et tenir à jour de la documentation sur les processus et les systèmes.
* Maintenir un inventaire exact des ressources de TI du PLC.
* Veiller à ce que les plans de reprise après sinistre informatique soient à jour et exécutables grâce à des tests réguliers et à une documentation adéquate.
* Surveiller les orientations et les pratiques exemplaires du secteur, ainsi que les technologies émergentes, pour recommander les améliorations continues à apporter à l’infrastructure de TI du PLC.
* Exécuter d’autres tâches, au besoin.

**Critères d’embauche**
-----------------------


* Minimum de deux années d’expérience dans le domaine du soutien technique dans un milieu de prestation de services au rythme soutenu et capacité éprouvée à résoudre un vaste éventail de problèmes techniques.
* Excellentes aptitudes en service à la clientèle, en communication et en résolution de problèmes, et capacité à expliquer des concepts techniques à des utilisateurs non initiés.
* Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à prioriser les tâches et à gérer des demandes multiples de manière efficace.
* Connaissance pratique de Microsoft Windows, de Microsoft 365 et de l’infonuagique hybride (comme Azure et AWS).
* Connaissance des fondements de la réseautique, des technologies d’accès à distance, des RPV, de la gestion de l’identité et de l’accès, de la gestion des terminaux, ainsi que de la sauvegarde et de la restauration des données.
* Connaissance pratique du langage SQL, notamment pour exécuter des requêtes de base et effectuer le dépannage des intégrations qui s’appuient sur des bases de données SQL.
* Des connaissances de base en rédaction de scripts ou en automatisation (PowerShell, par exemple) sont considérées comme un atout.
* Compréhension des pratiques exemplaires en cybersécurité, comme la gestion des correctifs, la gestion des vulnérabilités et les principes de sécurité infonuagique.
* Un baccalauréat ou un diplôme collégial dans un domaine technologique est un atout.
* Les certifications techniques comme AWS cloud Practitioner, Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Security\+ constituent des atouts.
* Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) constitue un atout.

**Postulez**
------------



Le PLC défend l’équité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous encourageons fortement les candidatures des groupes visés par l’équité en emploi, notamment les femmes, les Autochtones, les personnes racisées, les personnes 2ELGBTQI\+ et les personnes vivant avec un handicap. Si vous vous considérez comme membre d’un groupe visé par l’équité en emploi, vous pouvez l’indiquer dans votre formulaire de candidature.



Cette offre d’emploi concerne un poste vacant existant. Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt envers ce poste, mais nous ne communiquerons qu’avec les personnes retenues pour un entretien. Le Parti libéral du Canada n’utilise pas l’intelligence artificielle pour trier, évaluer ou sélectionner des candidats.



Le PLC souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi et examinera toute demande d’accommodement s’appuyant sur une contre\-indication médicale, la religion ou tout autre motif de discrimination illicite en vertu des lois en vigueur en matière de droits de la personne.



Le PLC invite toutes les personnes qualifiées à poser leur candidature. Le PLC a un excellent bilan relatif au soutien aux personnes handicapées. Veuillez envoyer un courriel au service des ressources humaines (hr\-rh@liberal.ca) si, pendant le processus de soumission de candidature, vous avez besoin d’un accommodement particulier ou souhaite

jobs.description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF\-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

  



We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000\+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

  



Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

  



Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

  



Join our team!

  


**I.T. Support Technician**



We are looking for a hands\-on I.T. Support Technician to provide onsite IT support for a location of approximately 120 users. This role will focus on supporting end\-user technology, including laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, collaboration tools, business applications, and day\-to\-day technical issues. The successful candidate will be customer\-focused, organized, and able to resolve issues efficiently while collaborating with the broader IT team when escalation is required.

  



Specific Responsibilities


* Provide onsite deskside support for approximately 120 users, ensuring a high level of customer service and timely resolution of technical issues.
* Support end\-user technology, including laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, mobile devices, printers, meeting room equipment, and collaboration tools.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network connectivity, Microsoft 365, VPN, printing, and business application issues.
* Install, configure, deploy, and replace IT equipment in accordance with company standards and asset lifecycle processes.
* Manage incidents and service requests through the ticketing system, ensuring accurate documentation, prioritization, follow\-up, and closure.
* Escalate complex issues to the appropriate IT teams or external partners while maintaining ownership of the user experience.
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, including workstation setup, account access coordination, equipment preparation, and user orientation.
* Maintain local IT inventory, track assigned assets, and coordinate equipment repairs, replacements, and returns as required.
* Create and maintain clear documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures to support consistent IT operations.
* Adhere to established IT policies, procedures, cybersecurity requirements, and service standards.

  



Position Requirements


* Technical diploma in Computer Systems, Information Technology, or equivalent experience preferred.
* Minimum of 4 to 6 years of experience in a deskside, service desk, field support, or IT support role.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for Windows workstations, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, printers, peripheral equipment, and common business applications.
* Experience supporting end users in an onsite environment with a strong focus on customer service and professionalism.
* Ability to prioritize incidents and service requests based on urgency, impact, and business needs.
* Responsible, autonomous, accountable, and able to work independently while collaborating with remote IT teams as needed.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, time\-management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and remain effective during urgent support situations.
* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar incident/request management tool preferred.
* A\+ certification, ITIL Foundation certification, or other relevant IT certifications considered an asset.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills in English and French.
* Availability to participate in after\-hours or on\-call support rotation, if required.
* Ability to travel as needed.
* Must have a valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle.
* Other duties as assigned.

  


**Security Clearance Requirements/ CGP / ITAR:**



Position requires Level II Clearance with the Canadian Government and the ability to gain access to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program.

  


**By joining Top Aces, you will find:**


* A work environment in which service, integrity, excellence and teamwork are highly valued;
* Opportunities for development and growth;
* Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration at a local and global level;
* A flexible schedule;
* Attractive benefit plan.

  



Come share your passion with us! Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**



At Top Aces, all employees are welcome regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability or age. The masculine form may be used in this job description solely for ease of reading but refers to men, women and gender diversity.

With flagship operations like the Côté Gold Mine in Ontario, one of Canada’s largest and most technologically advanced gold mines, we’re not just mining gold; we’re redefining what mining means for the future.


At IAMGOLD, we believe that when we engage, empower, and support each other, we create extraordinary outcomes—delivering value for our people, partners, and stakeholders while building stronger, more resilient communities.  

Recognized as one of the 2025 GTA Top Employers, we offer an environment designed for growth, world\-class rewards, cutting\-edge development programs, and a culture that values fresh ideas and collaboration.


Our results speak for themselves: ranked 13th on the 2025 TSX30, we’ve proven that performance and purpose go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work on projects that matter, leveraging technology, sustainability, and creativity to deliver impact for our teams, communities, and the planet.

IAMGOLD is seeking a motivated and hands\-on **Field Technician (Exploration)** to support multiple active exploration projects in the Côté Gold region. Based out of the Mesomikenda Lake core shack, this role plays a key part in ensuring exploration programs run safely, efficiently, and successfully across a variety of remote field locations.


Working closely with geologists and field teams, the Field Technician will provide both logistical and technical support for diamond drilling programs, geological mapping, geochemical and geophysical surveys, and sample collection activities. The successful candidate will coordinate and support drilling operations on both land and ice, oversee field logistics and inventory management, and assist with contractor coordination during trenching, site preparation, and reclamation activities. Strong organizational and communication skills, proficiency with GPS technology and basic GIS applications, and solid computer skills are important for success in this role. If you enjoy working outdoors, thrive in dynamic exploration environments, and are passionate about contributing to the discovery and development of mineral resources, we invite you to join IAMGOLD and help support the future of responsible mining.

The final offer is determined based on your individual skills, qualifications, and competencies and aligned with our commitment to internal equity.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer, Emergency Call Handling
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

Department Overview

Emergency Call Handling is the critical interface for the citizen into the command center, public safety workflow. We are the leading solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 call centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. We are part of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise, where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness. This software developer position will be a member of the team working on software applications for Public Safety.

Présentation Du Département

La gestion des appels d'urgence est l'interface essentielle du citoyen avec le centre de commandement et le flux de travail de la sécurité publique. Nous sommes le principal fournisseur de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence, le logiciel qui permet aux centres d'appels 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres d'appels de la sécurité publique (CASP) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. Nous faisons partie de la division Logiciels d'entreprise (Software Enterprise) de Motorola Solutions, où sont développées des innovations pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, à la répartition des intervenants et à la connaissance de la situation. Ce poste de développeur de logiciels fait partie de l'équipe travaillant sur des applications logicielles pour la sécurité publique.

Job Description

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the team developing the VESTA 9-1-1 Call Handling solution. In this role, you will leverage agentic AI to build applications, automate DevOps and Cybersecurity workflows, improving quality and operational efficiency.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real-time pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

What You’ll Do

Develop components for and integrate services into our Emergency Call Handling Systems
Develop Agentic AI-powered automation workflows to improve efficiency of our DevOps and Cybersecurity tasks.
Help integrate AI techniques to improve evaluation, testing, and observability for our systems.
Get your hands dirty setting up and configuring hardware and software, including network devices and servers.
Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.

You Might Be a Fit If

You enjoy converting manual, tedious procedures to autonomous AI-powered workflows then jumping onto the next high-impact challenge.
You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
You take feedback well and act on it.
You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
You thrive in a team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.

Relevant Experience

We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.

Relevant Exposure May Include

Projects involving AI agents, AI pipelines or RAG systems.
Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport.
Exposure to DevOps, Automation and CI/CD systems using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, Github, Artifactory
Programming in Python, C#, C++, Java, or similar languages
Comfortable scripting in both Linux and Windows and virtualization.
Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest.

Target Base Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000 CAD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Description Du Poste

Nous recherchons un ingénieur logiciel pour se joindre à l'équipe de développement de la solution de gestion des appels VESTA 9-1-1. Dans ce rôle, vous exploiterez l'IA agentique pour créer des applications, automatiser les flux de travail DevOps et de cybersécurité, améliorant ainsi la qualité et l'efficacité opérationnelle.

Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'ingénieurs expérimentés sur les pipelines en temps réel, la téléphonie, l'infrastructure back-end et les interfaces produit. Vous contribuerez à influencer l'architecture, à concevoir des fonctionnalités fondamentales et à façonner la manière dont notre équipe utilise les agents d'IA pour progresser plus rapidement, sans faire de compromis sur la fiabilité, la sécurité ou la qualité du produit. Nous encourageons nos ingénieurs à utiliser des agents d'IA dans leur propre travail. Cependant, s'agissant d'un logiciel hautement critique, les humains conservent la responsabilité de la qualité, du jugement et de ce qui est déployé.

Ce que vous ferez

Développer des composants et intégrer des services dans nos systèmes de gestion des appels d'urgence.
Développer des flux de travail d'automatisation alimentés par l'IA agentique pour améliorer l'efficacité de nos tâches DevOps et de cybersécurité.
Contribuer à l'intégration de techniques d'IA pour améliorer l'évaluation, les tests et l'observabilité de nos systèmes.
Mettre la main à la pâte pour installer et configurer du matériel et des logiciels, y compris des équipements réseau et des serveurs.
Adopter de solides habitudes autour des tests, de la revue de code, de l'observabilité et de la sécurité dès le premier jour.
Poser des questions, chercher à comprendre le fonctionnement des systèmes et apporter des perspectives nouvelles à l'équipe.

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si

Vous aimez transformer des procédures manuelles et fastidieuses en flux de travail autonomes basés sur l'IA, avant de vous lancer dans le prochain défi à fort impact.
Vous êtes curieux de travailler sur le back-end, l'infrastructure, l'IA et le produit, même si vous n'avez pas encore touché à tout.
Vous utilisez des outils d'IA au quotidien, mais vous ne confondez pas rapidité et qualité.
Vous vous souciez de la qualité : rédigez des tests, lisez la documentation et essayez de comprendre un système avant de le modifier.
Vous acceptez bien les commentaires et agissez en conséquence.
Vous avez un fort instinct produit et vous vous souciez des humains qui utilisent ce que vous construisez.
Vous vous épanouissez dans une équipe où vous aurez une réelle autonomie dès le début, tout en étant à l'aise pour demander de l'aide.

Expérience pertinente

Nous ne nous attendons pas à ce que vous ayez déjà déployé des systèmes en production. Nous accordons de l'importance avant tout aux principes fondamentaux de l'ingénierie, à la rapidité d'apprentissage, à la curiosité et à votre façon de penser. Les cours, les stages, la recherche et les projets personnels sont tous pris en compte.

Les compétences ou expériences pertinentes peuvent inclure :

La programmation en Python, C#, C++, Java ou des langages similaires.
Des systèmes de communication en temps réel utilisant WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, le streaming média ou le transport audio à faible latence.
Une expérience avec les systèmes DevOps, d'automatisation et de CI/CD à l'aide d'outils tels que TeamCity, Jenkins, GitHub, Artifactory.
Des projets impliquant des agents d'IA, des pipelines d'IA ou des systèmes RAG.
Une aisance avec le scripting sous Linux et Windows, ainsi qu'avec la virtualisation.
L'infrastructure de téléphonie et de voix, y compris le réseau téléphonique public commuté (RTPC/PSTN), le trunking SIP, le PBX et le routage des appels.

Vous n'avez pas besoin d'avoir de l'expérience dans tous ces domaines. La plupart des candidats retenus en maîtriseront quelques-uns et auront la curiosité d'apprendre le reste.

Fourchette de salaire de base cible : $70,000 - $90,000 CAD

Conformément aux valeurs de Motorola Solutions et à la législation en vigueur, nous communiquons les informations suivantes afin de favoriser la transparence et l'équité salariales.
