jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.description:
### **About PixMob**


PixMob creates magical experiences for live events around the world ✨. You might have seen 60,000 fans light up at the Super Bowl or at a Coldplay concert. Our mission? To spark joy and unforgettable memories for every fan.


We work with international artists, event organizers, sports teams, and brands to make every event extra special. At PixMob, innovation and design are in our DNA. From rapid prototyping to mass manufacturing, we craft cutting\-edge wireless tech right at our Montreal HQ. And we care about the planet —we fight single\-use plastics and use recycled or compostable materials wherever we can.

**We’re looking for an IT Support Technician**

### **About the role**


We're looking for an IT Support Technician to join our team in Montreal. You'll be the first person our colleagues turn to when something isn't working, whether they're sitting next to you in the office or working remotely. The role is hands\-on: fixing problems, setting up laptops, keeping our inventory straight and making sure meeting rooms just work.


This is an entry\-level position. If you've recently finished a DEC, DEP or AEC in IT support and have some real\-world experience from an internship, a previous job or serious school projects, we'd like to hear from you. You'll learn a lot, and you'll have room to grow into more technical work over time.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* Handle first\-line support requests coming in through Jira, chat or people walking up to your desk
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues on **macOS** (about 90% of our fleet) and Windows (about 10%), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Calendar) and everyday business apps
* Prepare, deploy and manage laptops through our MDM tools (Mosyle for Macs, NinjaOne for Windows)
* Run onboarding and offboarding: create and disable accounts, set up equipment, make sure new hires are ready on day one
* Keep the hardware inventory and asset tracking up to date (laptops, monitors, peripherals, accessories)
* Look after meeting rooms and AV equipment: screens, video conferencing, cabling, and quick fixes when a meeting is about to start
* Keep the office IT setup in good shape: desks, docking stations, monitors, cable management, and setting up or moving workstations when people join or change seats
* Document fixes and write short how\-to guides so people can help themselves
* Escalate to senior team members when needed, with clear notes on what you've already tried
* Basic network and printer troubleshooting

### **What we’re looking for**

* DEC, DEP or AEC in IT support, computer science or a related field
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience, internships and school projects count
* Comfortable supporting macOS users and Google Workspace; some Windows experience is a plus
* Bilingual, French and English, spoken and written (you'll support people in both languages every day)
* Good at explaining technical things to non\-technical people, patient, and calm when several requests land at once
* Organized, reliable, and able to keep track of tickets and inventory without being chased
* Able to be in the office regularly for walk\-in support and hardware work

**Nice to have**

* Experience with a ticketing system (Jira Service Management or similar)
* Familiarity with an MDM or RMM tool (Mosyle, NinjaOne, Jamf, Kandji)
* Exposure to Linux
* Basic networking knowledge (Wi\-Fi, DHCP, VPN)
* Experience with AV or video conferencing setups (Google Meet hardware, Zoom Rooms)

### **Languages \& Inclusivity**


You’ll need to be fluent in English (written \& spoken), as day\-to\-day work involves collaboration with international employees — US, Europe, Asia\-Pacific, and more.


Inclusivity is at the heart of our culture . We welcome and value candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our job posting uses simplified grammar to make it easier to read across languages and is not intended to exclude or favor any gender.


Join us to help build a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected and empowered ✨.

*Thanks for your interest in PixMob and this role! Only selected candidates will be contacted.*

Sonepar IT Help Desk associates provide quality IT support via phone, email, virtual meeting, and after\-hours mobile phone. À titre de technicien(ne) en soutien informatique – Niveau 2, vous serez responsable du traitement quotidien des demandes de soutien, de l'intégration et du départ des employés, du déploiement de matériel informatique ainsi que de l'administration de logiciels dans nos bureaux au Canada et aux États\-Unis. * **Intégration et départ des employés** – Préparer les ordinateurs portables, les périphériques et les comptes pour les nouveaux employés; révoquer rapidement les accès des employés quittant l'entreprise.

Le Groupe ALDO est une entreprise d’envergure internationale qui crée et commercialise des chaussures et accessoires mode depuis plus de 50 ans. jobs.title: L2 IT Support - NETE
jobs.description:
Job title: L2 IT Support


Location: Lasalle, Montreal


Work Arrangement: Onsite


About the role


Join an IT team supporting all users (local and remote) at Weir Canada Inc. As a member of the Support Team, within the Testing and Infrastructure Support (TIS) Section, you will support, troubleshoot, deploy, and improve diverse technologies that enable business and operational capabilities for the company and its users.


What we do at Weir


At Weir, we combine engineering expertise, innovation, and technology to solve complex challenges for customers around the world. In this role, you'll apply those strengths in support of mission\-critical naval systems, contributing to the reliability, security, and performance of environments that are essential to Canada's maritime defence capabilities.


What you’ll do


In this role, you will provide IT support for the internal network which provides office automation and various tools to the users (local and remote). This position is ideal for a resourceful, hands\-on IT professional who enjoys solving problems and supporting users.


Make Your Impact


We value what you can do—not just where you’ve been. If you meet the goals of the role, we want to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities

* Provide network infrastructure support for all Microsoft Windows production servers by updating, maintaining and patching.
* Provide support for all Microsoft Windows workstations (desktops and laptops) by updating, maintaining and patching.
* Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot data backups via a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) / Veeam backup solution as well as ongoing disaster recovery support.
* Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve outages, bottlenecks, vulnerabilities, and other operational issues.
* Support core network and system services, including Cisco technologies, Microsoft Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and security platforms.
* Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, asset records, and technical procedures while ensuring compliance with security and operational best practices.
* Coordinate life\-cycling of all hardware on the network (i.e. servers, workstations, networking devices, security devices, etc.).
* Provide support to end users.


Must\-haves:

* DEC, Certification, or University Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
* Minimum 5 years of IT infrastructure and network support experience, including experience supporting enterprise network environments.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network and security issues.
* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, VMware, virtualization platforms.
* Experience with data backup and disaster recovery systems.
* Excellent customer service, organizational, and communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.


Mandatory Requirement: Canadian citizenship, with 10 or more years residing in Canada with no periods longer than six continuous months out of country, is absolutely necessary as part of the requirements to obtain a government security clearance to the minimum level of Secret


Nice\-to\-haves (desirable):

* Working knowledge of Citrix environments and Citrix NetScaler ADC Gateway appliances.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, security best practices, and vulnerability management.
* Experience supporting Cisco networking technologies, network protocols (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, QoS), firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, and web/email security solutions.
* Can communicate equally well with senior leaders, engineers, technicians, and end users.


Why join Weir?


We live our values—we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.


We’re passionate about our purpose—to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world class engineering, materials science expertise and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end\-to\-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.


We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

*Benefits*

* Competitive pay
* Career development and study/learning support
* Access to global inclusion networks
* Regional and team\-specific benefits
* ShareBuilder program, allowing purchase of publicly traded shares of Weir
* Wellness support for you and your family
* Collaboration with global teams

L’équipe de MDA Space, qui compte plus de 4 000 experts du secteur spatial au Canada, aux États\-Unis et au Royaume\-Uni, possède les connaissances et le savoir\-faire nécessaires pour transformer la vision audacieuse du client en une mission réalisable, grâce à une combinaison unique d’expérience, d’excellence technique et d’émerveillement qui fait partie de notre ADN depuis le premier jour. * Rendre compte périodiquement des risques à la direction en mettant en évidence les problèmes et les cas complexes.

**Qualifications et expérience requises :**

jobs.title: Network Field Technician
jobs.description:
Technicien(ne) de réseau – Services sur le terrain

**Viverlink Networks Inc. \| Montréal, Québec**  
**Type d’emploi :** Temps plein  
**Mode de travail :** Sur site / travail sur le terrain  
**Lieu :** Montréal et partout au Québec  
**Déplacements :** Des déplacements réguliers entre différents sites clients à Montréal et dans d’autres régions du Québec peuvent être requis.

À propos de Viverlink Networks

Viverlink Networks Inc. est un fournisseur de services gérés sur le terrain (Managed Field Services Provider – MFSP) en pleine croissance. Nous soutenons des fournisseurs de services TI (MSP), des entreprises technologiques, des équipes TI d’entreprise et des organisations possédant plusieurs établissements.

Nous assurons l’exécution technique sur site et faisons le lien entre les opérations TI à distance et les interventions physiques nécessaires chez les clients.

Nos services comprennent notamment :

* Soutien informatique et technique sur site
* Installation et déploiement de réseaux et de solutions de connectivité
* Déploiements d’infrastructures et projets technologiques
* Déploiement de matériel et de postes de travail
* Câblage structuré et infrastructure réseau physique
* Installations liées à la sécurité et à la conformité

Nos interventions sont réalisées à partir de bons de travail définis, de procédures professionnelles, d’exigences de documentation et de communications structurées avec les équipes TI à distance et les gestionnaires de projets.

Dans le cadre de notre expansion au Québec, nous développons un réseau professionnel de services techniques sur le terrain et recherchons des techniciens qui souhaitent évoluer avec l’organisation et participer progressivement à des mandats plus complexes.

Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) **technicien(ne) de réseau – services sur le terrain** capable de travailler de façon autonome chez les clients à Montréal et partout au Québec et de représenter Viverlink de manière professionnelle.

Il s’agit d’un poste pratique et terrain comprenant notamment l’installation d’équipements réseau, le dépannage, le câblage structuré, le déploiement de matériel et le soutien technique sur site.

Le travail est généralement effectué à partir de bons de travail détaillés et peut nécessiter une collaboration avec des ingénieurs à distance, des équipes MSP, des gestionnaires de projets et des représentants des clients.

La personne recherchée n’a pas besoin de tout maîtriser dès le premier jour. Nous recherchons surtout une personne possédant de bonnes bases techniques, une approche structurée du dépannage, une communication professionnelle et une réelle volonté d’apprendre et de progresser.

Responsabilités principalesRéseaux et infrastructure

* Installer, remplacer, configurer et tester des équipements réseau tels que des commutateurs, routeurs, points d’accès sans fil et équipements connexes.
* Effectuer du dépannage de base de la connectivité réseau à l’aide des concepts TCP/IP et des méthodes de diagnostic courantes.
* Identifier et résoudre les problèmes liés à l’infrastructure physique et au réseau.
* Effectuer des travaux de câblage structuré, notamment le cheminement, la terminaison, l’étiquetage, le raccordement et les tests de base.
* Installer et organiser les équipements réseau dans des baies, cabinets et environnements clients.
* Participer aux mises à niveau réseau, déploiements technologiques, remplacements de matériel et déploiements multisites.
* Effectuer le remplacement et l’installation de matériel conformément aux instructions approuvées.

Exécution des interventions sur le terrain

* Examiner les bons de travail et les exigences du site avant l’intervention.
* Se présenter sur place avec les outils, les informations et le matériel nécessaires.
* Respecter les instructions propres au client, la documentation technique, les procédures du site et les règles de sécurité.
* Travailler de façon autonome tout en maintenant une communication efficace avec les équipes techniques à distance.
* Signaler les problèmes qui dépassent la portée de l’intervention ou les compétences autorisées.
* Ne pas effectuer de modifications non autorisées dans les environnements des clients.

Documentation et rapports

* Maintenir à jour les informations relatives aux bons de travail et aux billets.
* Documenter les travaux effectués, les constatations, les changements apportés, les numéros de série et les observations pertinentes.
* Prendre les photographies et recueillir les autres éléments de preuve requis pour confirmer la réalisation des travaux.
* Communiquer clairement les problèmes, les obstacles et les travaux restant à effectuer.
* Produire des rapports d’intervention professionnels conformément aux exigences de Viverlink et du client.

Interaction avec les clients

* Représenter Viverlink de manière professionnelle chez les clients.
* Communiquer clairement avec les contacts sur place et le personnel du client.
* Gérer les attentes et fournir des mises à jour précises sur l’état de l’intervention.
* Maintenir une attitude professionnelle dans les bureaux, commerces, installations techniques et autres environnements clients.
* Protéger les renseignements des clients et respecter les exigences applicables en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité.

Qualifications recherchées

Nous recherchons des candidats possédant une expérience pratique dans plusieurs des domaines suivants :

Réseautique

* Bonne compréhension de base des réseaux TCP/IP.
* Connaissance des commutateurs, routeurs, points d’accès sans fil et du câblage réseau.
* Capacité à effectuer du dépannage de base de la connectivité.
* Compréhension de l’adressage IP, d’Ethernet, des concepts de VLAN et de la terminologie réseau courante.

Câblage et infrastructure physique

* Expérience en câblage structuré.
* Capacité à terminer, étiqueter, organiser et tester des câbles réseau.
* Connaissance des panneaux de brassage, baies, cabinets et systèmes de gestio

**FAITES CARRIÈRE AU CSSRS!**


Vous souhaitez inspirer le plaisir d'apprendre, de se dépasser et aider à multiplier les réussites des jeunes de la région? Au CSSRS tous y contribuent en additionnant leurs forces!


**Votre environnement de travail**


Une organisation qui a pour mission la réussite scolaire et sociale de près de 27 000 élèves dans 47 écoles et centres incluant 2 écoles spécialisées.


**Vos conditions d'emploi**


 **Horaires :** 35h par semaine, du lundi au vendredi, en mode hybride


 **Salaire**: entre 27\.78$ et 37\.08$ de l'heure, selon les qualifications et l'expériences en conformité avec la convention collective en vigueur.


**Votre mission**


Le rôle principal et habituel de la personne salariée de cette classe d’emplois consiste à programmer ou modifier des applications maison, à assumer la gestion de réseaux, à effectuer les dépannages les plus complexes auprès des utilisatrices et utilisateurs de l’informatique, et à assister les analystes en informatique dans la conception et l’élaboration de systèmes.


**Votre apport au quotidien**


Au quotidien, vous serez au coeur du service de soutien informatique. Vous assurerez la prise en charge, l’orientation et la résolution à distance des incidents et demandes transmis au Service des technologies de l’information.  

Vous serez appelé à :  

* Assurer la prise en charge et la résolution à distance des incidents et demandes confiés.
* Recueillir l'information pertinente, analyser les situations signalées, explorer les pistes de solution appropriées et assurer le suivi jusqu'à leur résolution ou leur transfert vers la ressource appropriée.
* Évaluer les messages reçus dans la boîte vocale d'urgence, appliquer les procédures établies et assurer le tri et l'orientation des demandes vers les bonnes équipes.
* Déterminer si une intervention sur place est requise et acheminer les travaux aux équipes appropriées selon la nature et la complexité de la situation.
* Collaborer avec les autres équipes du Service des technologies de l'information lorsque la résolution nécessite une expertise complémentaire, en leur transmettant les constats, les vérifications effectuées et les pistes explorées.
* Reconnaître les incidents pouvant avoir un impact plus large, en évaluer la portée et en signaler rapidement les effets aux intervenants concernées.
* Effectuer certaines interventions liées aux accès, aux regroupements et à la distribution d'applications, conformément aux procédures établies.
* Soutenir les utilisateurs dans la résolution des situations qui leur sont confiées, contribuer au partage des connaissances au sein de l’équipe et participer à différents projets d’amélioration des services.
* Appliquer les mesures favorisant une utilisation efficace et sécuritaire des technologies.
* Au besoin, accomplir toute autre tâche connexe.


*Note : La description ci\-dessus représente la situation et l’environnement actuels et peut être appelée à changer*
**Ce qui fera votre succès dans ce rôle**


* Vous placez le service à la clientèle au coeur de vos interventions.
* Vous savez poser les bonnes questions et comprendre rapidement les besoins des utilisateurs.
* Vous communiquez efficacement et demeurez calme même lors des périodes de pointe.
* Vous faites preuve de jugement dans l'évaluation des priorités et l'aiguillage des demandes.
* Vous aimez rechercher des solutions et comprendre le fonctionnement des technologies.
* Vous êtes autonome tout en appréciant la collaboration et le partage des connaissances.


**Une occasion de contribuer concrètement**


Travailler au sein du Service des technologies de l'information du CSSRS, c'est contribuer concrètement au quotidien des établissements scolaires tout en développant une connaissance diversifiée de notre environnement technologique. Vous aurez l'occasion de collaborer avec les différentes équipes TI et de participer à des projets qui soutiennent directement la réussite éducative.


**Vos diplômes et formations**


* Être titulaire d'un diplôme d'études collégiales en techniques de l'informatique avec option informatique de gestion ou être titulaire d'un diplôme ou d'une attestation d'études dont l'équivalence est reconnue par l'autorité compétente.
* Avoir une excellente maîtrise du français parlé et écrit.


**POSTULEZ DÈS MAINTENANT ET FAITES PARTIE DE L'ÉQUATION!**

  


*Le CSSRS remercie tous les candidats et les candidates de leur intérêt, mais ne communiquera qu’avec les personnes retenues.*


*Le CSSRS applique un programme d'accès à l'égalité en emploi et invite les femmes, les minorités visibles et ethniques, les autochtones et les personnes handicapées à présenter leur candidature. Les personnes handicapées peuvent recevoir de l'assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection, si elles le désirent.*

jobs.description:
**VOTRE GROUPE DE TRAVAIL**


Service des technologies de l’information

  

  

**SOMMAIRE DE LA FONCTION**


La personne détentrice du poste effectue divers travaux techniques reliés à la configuration d’équipements et de systèmes informatiques et de communication, à la maintenance et à l’optimisation de nos serveurs physiques et virtuels, à la programmation, à l’installation et à la configuration de logiciels et de systèmes d’exploitation, ainsi qu’au traitement des alertes émises par les logiciels et les équipements. Elle participe à l’analyse des besoins de la clientèle et lui procure assistance et soutien.


**TÂCHES ET RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES**


* Participe à l’analyse détaillée des spécifications des systèmes selon un cadre déjà établi et analyse les impératifs et les possibilités de réalisation de programmes.
* Assiste et conseille les personnes utilisatrices sur l’utilisation rationnelle des systèmes d’exploitation, des logiciels, des progiciels et des différentes technologies.
* Participe à l’évaluation des besoins, à l’installation, à la vérification, à la configuration et à la résolution de problèmes liés à l’infrastructure, aux logiciels et aux progiciels dédiés à l’administration, à l’enseignement et à la recherche. Effectue les recherches nécessaires, communique avec les personnes concernées en cas de mauvais fonctionnement des systèmes et assure le suivi.
* Assiste, dépanne et conseille les personnes utilisatrices des différents systèmes, programmes ou équipements relevant de son secteur. Assure le soutien technique et participe à leur formation.
* Prépare et tient à jour les diagrammes généraux et détaillés de l’architecture technologique et des logiciels associés.
* Évalue les besoins, propose des solutions et optimise les systèmes existants pour tenir compte des demandes formulées par la clientèle, des changements dans les exigences des systèmes ou dans les structures de l’équipement. Participe à la recherche des causes de mauvais fonctionnement des équipements.
* Maintient les serveurs à jour et veille à leur disponibilité et à leur performance optimale.
* Participe à la planification de la capacité et à la stratégie d’évolution de l’infrastructure.
* Accomplit temporairement les tâches d’un poste connexe ou inférieur, lorsque requis.
* La liste des tâches et responsabilités énumérées est sommaire et indicative. Il ne s’agit pas d’une liste complète et détaillée des tâches et responsabilités susceptibles d’être effectuées par une personne salariée occupant ce poste. Cependant, les tâches et responsabilités non énumérées ne doivent pas avoir d’effet sur la catégorie.


**EXIGENCES**


* Diplôme d’études collégiales (DEC) en informatique ou scolarité équivalente.
* Deux (2\) années d’expérience pertinente.


Toute combinaison de scolarité et d’expérience peut être acceptée si jugée pertinente par l’employeur.


**CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES**


* Connaissance approfondie des environnements Windows, Nutanix et infonuagiques (AWS et Azure).
* Capacité à rédiger des scripts d’automatisation (PowerShell, Bash, etc.).
* Connaissance approfondie des infrastructures de serveurs virtuels, notamment des serveurs à lames, du stockage réseau (SAN et NAS) et des équipements de sauvegarde.
* Maîtrise des technologies et services suivants : MS Exchange, Active Directory, GPO, DFS, DNS, DHCP, LDAP, systèmes d’authentification (SSO et certificats), MS SQL Server et IIS.
* Connaissance des équipements et protocoles réseau (pare\-feu, commutateurs, etc.), des équipements robotisés et des logiciels de sauvegarde, dont Veeam.
* Sens de l’organisation, autonomie et esprit de collaboration.


**MODE DE TRAVAIL**


Télétravail, sauf besoins occasionnels de présence au bureau de Québec.


**TYPE DE POSTE**


Poste régulier


**MILIEU INCLUSIF**


L’Université TÉLUQ souscrit aux programmes d’accès à l’égalité et l’équité en matière d’emploi et valorise la diversité et l’inclusion au sein de sa communauté. De ce fait, elle invite toutes les personnes qui répondent aux exigences du poste à soumettre leur candidature, en particulier les femmes, les autochtones, les membres des minorités visibles, des minorités ethniques et les personnes en situation de handicap. Nous encourageons toutes les personnes qualifiées à postuler.


L'Université TÉLUQ souscrit avec conviction aux principes d'équité, de diversité et d'inclusion (EDI). Elle reconnaît l'importance de l'EDI dans la poursuite de l'excellence en enseignement et en recherche. Ainsi, l'Université TÉLUQ entend non seulement contribuer à une meilleure représentativité de la collectivité canadienne au sein des milieux de recherche canadiens, mais également à promouvoir l'excellence en recherche, et ce, de façon durable. Dans cette optique, l'Université TÉLUQ s'engage à devenir, par ses actions, un chef de file en matière de diversité, d'équité et d'inclusion.


Enfin, sur demande, le processus de recrutement peut être adapté selon les besoins des personnes vivant avec des limitations.


***Si vous rencontrez des difficultés avec le dépôt de votre candidature, contactez*** ***support@workland.com***

jobs.description:
Depuis 1983, Pharmascience contribue à améliorer la santé et le bien\-être des patients au Canada et dans plus de 50 pays. En tant que 1er fabricant pharmaceutique de propriété canadienne et entreprise reconnue parmi les 50 meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada, nous croyons que notre succès repose avant tout sur le talent et l'engagement de nos équipes.


**Joignez\-vous à nous! Nous recrutons pour un poste d'Analyste junior en cybersécurité.**



En tant qu'analyste junior en cybersécurité, vous soutiendrez les opérations de sécurité de Pharmascience et contribuerez au renforcement de notre maturité en matière de cybersécurité. Sous le mentorat des analystes seniors, vous surveillerez et trierez les alertes de sécurité, participerez à la réponse aux incidents et développerez une expertise pratique de notre écosystème technologique, y compris la suite de sécurité Microsoft. Nous recherchons une personne motivée, dotée d'un esprit curieux et analytique, d'une grande rigueur et d'une réelle volonté d'apprendre et de progresser dans un environnement technologique complexe.

  


**Responsabilités:**


**Surveillance de sécurité et triage des alertes:**


* Surveiller les alertes de sécurité provenant de nos plateformes de détection (SIEM, EDR, sécurité courriel) et effectuer le triage de premier niveau.
* Analyser et qualifier les événements de sécurité, puis escalader les incidents confirmés selon les procédures établies.
* Documenter les investigations et maintenir des dossiers précis dans les outils de suivi des incidents.


**Soutien à la réponse aux incidents:**


* Participer à la réponse aux incidents de sécurité sous la supervision des analystes seniors.
* Exécuter les actions de confinement et de remédiation en suivant les playbooks établis.
* Contribuer à la documentation post\-incident et aux leçons apprises.


**Opération des outils de sécurité:**


* Utiliser et opérer quotidiennement la suite de sécurité Microsoft (Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, etc.).
* Contribuer au maintien et à la surveillance de l'état de santé des outils de sécurité (SIEM, EDR, NDR, etc.).
* Participer à l'amélioration des règles de détection et à l'automatisation sous supervision.


**Soutien à la gestion des vulnérabilités:**


* Participer aux analyses de vulnérabilités et au suivi des efforts de remédiation.
* Assurer le suivi auprès des équipes TI pour la résolution des vulnérabilités identifiées.
* Contribuer aux activités de sensibilisation à la sécurité au sein de l'organisation.


**Gouvernance, risques et conformité (GRC):**


* Soutenir les activités de conformité liées à la réglementation du secteur pharmaceutique.
* Contribuer à la préparation des audits de sécurité et à la collecte des preuves de conformité.
* Participer au maintien de la documentation et des procédures de sécurité.

  


**Compétences et expérience:**


* Expérience : 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité ou en TI (les stages, incluant les stages coop, sont considérés).
* Connaissances Microsoft : Bonne compréhension de la suite de sécurité Microsoft (par ex. Defender, Sentinel) et forte volonté d'approfondir cette expertise.
* Compétences analytiques : Bonnes capacités d'analyse, curiosité intellectuelle et rigueur dans l'application des procédures et la documentation des investigations.
* Connaissances techniques : Connaissances de base dans les domaines suivants : réseaux (TCP/IP), systèmes d'exploitation Windows et Linux, notions de gestion des identités et des accès (IAM) et principes fondamentaux de sécurité.
* Bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais compte tenu des interactions avec des fournisseurs externes hors province.

  




**Qualifications:**


* Certifications : Les certifications de niveau débutant telles que CompTIA Security\+, Microsoft SC\-900, AZ\-900 ou SC\-200 constituent un atout.
* Expérience dans l'industrie : Une expérience ou un stage dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou dans un environnement réglementé constitue un atout.
* Compétences en script : Des connaissances de base en langages de script (par ex. PowerShell, Python) constituent un atout.

  


**Avantages de travailler chez Pharmascience :**


* Boni annuel de performance
* Programme de référencement interne allant jusqu’à 3000$
* Vacances et congés mobiles octroyés dès l'embauche
* Couverture d'assurance collective dès jour 1 incluant la télémédecine
* Régime de retraite compétitif avec contribution de l'employeur dès jour 1
* Programme d'aide aux employés
* Formation continue offerte
* Environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif
* Stationnement sur place
* Gym

#### **Expérience**


Obligatoire* 1 \- 3 years: 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité ou en TI.

#### **Scolarité**


Préféré* Baccalauréat or better in Informatique \- Computer Science
* Diplôme d'études collégiales or better in Informatique \- Computer Science

jobs.title: Junior Risk & Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies \- Questrade, Questbank, Questrade Wealth Management, Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. We use cutting\-edge technology to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.
  
At QFG, we combine human\-centric collaboration with AI\-driven innovation to redefine financial services. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, using AI to transform and deliver unparalleled customer experiences and shaping a future where AI empowers our teams to do their best work.
  
Join our diverse, inclusive, and hybrid workplace to unleash your creativity and nurture your curiosity without limits. If you share this sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.
  
  

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?
  
* Health \& wellbeing resources and programs
* Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work\-life balance
* Competitive compensation and benefits packages
* Work\-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
* Career growth and development opportunities
* Opportunities to contribute to community causes
* Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment


This job posting is for an existing vacancy.
  
  

We’re looking for our next Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst. Could It Be You?
  
Safeguard Questrade’s capital and operational integrity by executing critical risk and credit functions across regular and extended trading hours.
  
The Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst actively monitors real\-time trading activity and market conditions to mitigate financial and operational exposure. In this role, the analyst ensures client positions align with established risk parameters, addresses account variances, and proactively intervenes to prevent excessive leverage or speculative overexposure. By enforcing margin compliance and maintaining accurate equity balances, the analyst protects both client accounts and the firm from capital losses and negative equity scenarios.
  
  

Need more details? Keep reading…
  
**In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
  
* Monitor Portfolio Concentration: Continuously analyze portfolio exposure to identify and mitigate single\-asset or sector concentration risks.
* Manage Margin Operations: Issue margin calls and instruct the Trade Desk to execute liquidations or coverage for deficient accounts.
* Oversee Proprietary Positions: Track real\-time market risk, leverage, and position limits across proprietary trading accounts.
* Validate Options Processing: Review and confirm option assignments and exercises to ensure accurate settlement and risk alignment.
* Deliver Risk Notifications: Communicate time\-sensitive alerts to clients regarding margin deficiencies, registered account (RRSP) negative balances and liquidations
* Assess Foreign Exchange Exposure: Monitor cross\-currency risk stemming from dual\-currency (USD/CAD) account balances and fluctuations.
* Mitigate Complex Derivatives Risk: Evaluate multi\-leg option strategies and direct the Trade Desk to close out positions posing critical assignment or exercise risk prior to expiry.
* Administer Cease Trade Order (CTO) Restrictions: Coordinate with Compliance and Trade Desk to apply and revoke trading restrictions on halted securities and confirm cancellation of open orders ahead of the evening CTO cutoff.
* Provide Extended\-Hours Support: Act as the primary risk resource for internal teams (Trade Desk, Compliance, Client Success, Sales) during late and extended trading sessions.
* Manage Extended\-Hours Exposure: Monitor market fluctuations and risk limits during pre\-market and after\-hours trading sessions.
* Drive Ad\-Hoc Analytics \& Projects: Conduct ad\-hoc risk reporting, process evaluations, and departmental optimization projects as required.


So are YOU our next Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst? You are if you…
  
* Post secondary degree/diploma in related or quantitative field
* CSI course completion is an asset (CSC, DFC, OLC)
* 1\+ years of financial industry experience
* 1\+ years experience in Risk
* A strong interest in and knowledge of the financial industry
* Strong interpersonal skill, ability to articulate complex information in a clear and concise manner
* Excellent MS Excel skill and G\-suite, Python, SQL, Power\-bi experience is preferred
* Working towards CFA/FRM designation is preferred


Additional Information…
  
* Fix term contract \- 12 months
* Hours: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM EST


**Compensation Information:**  

* Base salary range: $55,000 \- $60,000
* The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full\-Time Permanent roles.


Sounds like you? Click below to apply!

This is an environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Here, the unique skills and experience you bring will be valued. Hamilton, ON, CA

With deep roots in North America and a strong footprint internationally, Aecon brings global expertise and proudly serves public and private sector clients through its Construction and Concessions segment.

  

Safety Always is not only our \#1 core value – it is the standard that anchors our culture. We believe the most ambitious projects deserve the most committed people. At Aecon, you won’t just build your career — you’ll help build what matters to enable future generations to thrive.

  

At Aecon, you can count on:


* **Safety Always.** Our number one core value. The safety of our people, projects, partners, and stakeholders is our priority focus – today and always.
* **Integrity.** We lead by example, with humility and courage.
* **Accountability.** We’re passionate about delivering on our commitments.

jobs.title: Représentant(e) du soutien technique / Technical Support Representative
jobs.description:
À propos d'Asteris
Asteris est un chef de file des technologies d'imagerie vétérinaire. Notre suite logicielle Keystone PACS permet aux cliniques, aux hôpitaux et aux spécialistes vétérinaires de stocker, de consulter, de partager et d'interpréter leurs images diagnostiques, des radiographies aux échographies et aux tomodensitométries, facilement et en toute sécurité, où qu'ils soient. Conçu spécifiquement pour le secteur vétérinaire, Keystone s'intègre aux principaux logiciels de gestion de pratique et soutient des flux de téléconsultation qui aident les vétérinaires à prendre des décisions médicales en toute confiance. Asteris fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, qui acquiert et fait croître des entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux.


Le poste
À titre de représentant(e) du soutien technique, vous aiderez les cliniques vétérinaires à assurer le bon fonctionnement de leurs flux de travail d'imagerie. Vous résoudrez les problèmes liés aux installations, aux intégrations et à la connectivité de Keystone PACS, et offrirez le soutien rapide et courtois sur lequel nos clients comptent, y compris dans les situations urgentes où les soins aux patients en dépendent.


Vos responsabilités* Répondre aux demandes de soutien des clients par téléphone, par courriel et au moyen du système de billetterie, et résoudre les problèmes rapidement
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes logiciels, réseau et de connectivité touchant le stockage, le transfert et la visualisation des images
* Soutenir les installations, les mises à niveau et les intégrations avec les modalités d'imagerie et les logiciels de gestion de pratique
* Installer, configurer et entretenir les systèmes des clients, et effectuer les mises à jour et les sauvegardes afin de protéger l'intégrité et la sécurité des données
* Gérer les comptes utilisateurs, les autorisations et les accès

* Former les clients sur les fonctionnalités de Keystone, les nouvelles versions et les pratiques exemplaires

Asteris is a leader in veterinary imaging technology. Asteris is part of Valsoft Corporation, which acquires and grows vertical market software companies.

What You'll Do* Respond to client support requests by phone, email, and ticketing system, and resolve issues quickly
* Troubleshoot software, network, and connectivity issues affecting image storage, transfer, and viewing
* Support installations, upgrades, and integrations with imaging modalities and practice management systems
* Install, configure, and maintain client systems, and perform updates and backups to protect data integrity and security
* Manage user accounts, permissions, and access
* Document and track every issue in the ticketing system, and write clear knowledge base articles
* Train clients on Keystone features, new releases, and best practices
* Escalate complex issues to Development and follow through to resolution
* Participate in an after\-hours / on\-call rotation for emergency support
* Share recurring issues and client feedback to help improve the product

  

**Requirements**  

  

Ce que vous apportez* Deux ans ou plus d'expérience en soutien technique, en centre de services ou en TI, idéalement auprès de clients de logiciels
* Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes dans des environnements Windows, en réseautique (TCP/IP, DNS, pare\-feu) et avec les outils de soutien à distance
* Communication claire et patiente avec des utilisateurs non techniques
* Grand sens des responsabilités et du suivi, et calme sous pression
* Expérience avec un système de billetterie


Atouts* Expérience avec les systèmes DICOM, PACS ou d'imagerie médicale
* Expérience dans le secteur vétérinaire ou des technologies de la santé
* Connaissance de SQL ou de la programmation de scripts de base


—


What You Bring* 2\+ years of technical support, help desk, or IT experience, ideally supporting software customers
* Solid troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls), and remote support tools
* Clear, patient communication with non\-technical users
* Strong ownership and follow\-through, with a calm approach under pressure
* Experience with a ticketing system


Nice to Have* Experience with DICOM, PACS, or medical imaging systems
* Background in veterinary or healthcare technology
* Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting

  

**Benefits**  

  

Ce que nous offrons* Salaire de base concurrentiel
* Assurances collectives complètes avec Canada Vie : soins de santé, soins dentaires, soins de la vue, santé mentale et soins paramédicaux, ainsi qu'assurance vie, assurance décès et mutilation accidentels (DMA), assurance maladies graves et assurance invalidité de courte et de longue durée
* Accès à un régime d'épargne\-retraite collectif a

jobs.title: IT Field Service Technician - Kelowna
jobs.description:
**Northern Computer Inc. (NCI)** is a leading Managed IT Services Provider dedicated to delivering exceptional technology solutions and support to businesses across British Columbia and Alberta. We pride ourselves on building strong client relationships, maintaining a collaborative team culture, and providing opportunities for professional growth and development.


We're looking for a motivated and customer\-focused Field Service Technician to join our growing team. If you enjoy working directly with clients, solving technical challenges, and being on the move rather than sitting behind a desk all day, we want to hear from you.

**Job Summary:**


Northern Computer’s Field Services team delivers on site expertise that keeps our clients productive and confident in their technology. You’ll be the face on site when it comes to resolving issues, completing proactive visits, installing gear, closing the loop in our systems, and partnering closely with the Service Desk, NOC/SOC, Projects, and Account Management. The role blends Tier 2 troubleshooting with disciplined documentation and client relationship skills.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Perform onsite technical support as the primary technician for client environments, handling Tier 1\- 2 issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and validate fixes for endpoint, network edge, and infrastructure problems.
* Complete proactive site visits on a regular cadence (weekly/biweekly/monthly/quarterly), documenting findings and routing follow ups.
* Install and stage hardware including server racks, access points, switches, firewalls, servers, and peripheral equipment.
* Execute device adds/moves/changes and support scheduled deployments in coordination with NOC, Service Desk, and Projects.
* Maintain high\-quality ticketing practices: clear documentation, time entries, photos, notes, and next steps.
* Update and validate IT Glue documentation after each onsite visit and whenever configurations change.
* Communicate clearly with end users and site contacts, providing professional, confidence building onsite interactions.
* Ensure that no hardware is left behind and maintain safe, well\-organized tools, loaner kits, and the company vehicle.
* Surface opportunities, risks, and project/quote needs to AM/TDM/SDM with complete context.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Minimum 3 years of IT Field Services experience.
* Minimum 3 years supporting business technology environments.
* Tier 2 to Tier 3 technical support experience.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
* Ability to lift 50 lbs.
* Ability to travel up to 75% of the time.

**Why Join Us:**

* Competitive salary and company provided vehicle.
* Extended health, dental, vision, life insurance, RRSP match, EAP, and paid time off.
* Work with a collaborative Service Desk, NOC/SOC, and Projects ecosystem.
* Clear expectations, KPIs, and structured growth paths within Northern Computer’s Field Services team.

**Benefits:**

* Company car
* Dental care
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On\-site parking
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Vision care


Experience:

* MSP: 2 years (required)


Language:

* English (required)


License/Certification:

* Driving License (required)


Willingness to travel:

* 75% (required)




* Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist (St Thomas Office)
jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  

For over 70 years Buckland has been working to help companies across the world experience global trade in a better way. Buckland employs a unique approach to global trade that focuses on combining trusted technologies and talented people that know how to use them. As a customer\-focused company, Buckland provides customers with a single source of unmatched Customs Brokerage (Canadian, US, Mexican), Trade Managed Solutions, Freight Forwarding, Trade Technologies and Warehousing/Distribution Services. Buckland strives to provide customized services in a memorable way.
  
  

Buckland is looking for an IT Support Specialist (St Thomas Office)
  
  

What you’ll be doing
  
This position is responsible for following ITIL/ITSM best practices, to identify, resolve issues and deliver improvements. The IT Support Specialist will engage with lines of business and teams to prioritize and complete service requests and support incidents and internal and external OLA’s and SLAs are met. IT Support Specialist are involved in remote and onsite support, documentation, constructing reference material, and provide trainings as necessary.
  
  

What we can offer you
  
* Competitive salary, benefits package, and matching retirement plan
* Compensation range: $55,000– $65,000 annually (subject to experience)
* A friendly, collaborative work environment
* Opportunities for professional development \& ongoing learning
* A chance to be part of a growing organization
* On\-site position


Key Responsibilities
  
* Field incoming helpdesk requests from end users via ticketing system, phone or in person.
* Installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of Windows systems.
* Assist with configuration, installation and maintenance of software, hardware, and telecommunications services such as: computers, software applications, printers, telephones, servers, and general office equipment.
* Participate in reviewing systems, testing, and deploying updates.
* Follow ITIL/ITSM best practices for incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
* Taking team and staff needs and improving solutions through planning, design, review, and installation tasks.
* Creating detailed documentation of IT resources and processes and updating support documentation with all daily tasks and as the product support grows.
* Fulfil requests coming from team members and leads to ensure hardware, software and network are available 98\+% of the time on a 24/7 basis, excluding scheduled downtime.
* Collaborate with other IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of support services and incident management processes.
* Provide afterhours on\-call support as required.
* Other responsibilities as assigned.


What we need from you
  
* Computer Science degree or diploma or equivalent education and work experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant work experience in a technical support position.
* ITIL Foundations certification.
* Knowledge of ITSM processes, tools, and best practices.
* Networking fundamentals or proven networking certification.
* Microsoft 365, PowerShell scripting and Azure experience.
* Experience with Virtual server technologies such as VMWare, Cloud Infrastructure, Microsoft Exchange online or equivalent cloud\-based system.
* Experience with Windows enterprise applications, Active Directory, IIS, file servers, etc.
* Experience in Microsoft SQL Server.
* Desktop support for PC environment supporting Windows 10 / 11 and Microsoft Office suite.
* Networking involving multiple platforms, Cisco/Nortel/HP/Dell/other vendors.
* Excellent problem solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Must be legally eligible to work for the Company at all times.
* Valid Passport ability to occasionally travel if required to other offices locations in CAD/USA/MEX.


Want to apply? Get in touch today
  
Please visit www.Buckland.com to apply to this current and open vacancy and to learn more about Buckland and the services we provide. The career page will highlight all current open positions and they can be found in this link. When applying, ensure to have your most up to date resume and all relevant documents related to your application ready to be uploaded.
  
Buckland provides equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on any protected ground under applicable human rights legislation. Applicants do not require CAD or USA work experience but for some positions may require CAD or USA standard regulations knowledge and experience. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, placement, promotion, compensation, transfer, leaves of absence, layoff, recall and termination.
  
Buckland may use artificial intelligence from time to time to screen, assess, or select applicants for employment, including for this position.
  
Buckland will work with and accommodate persons with disabilities throughout the entire recruitment, selection, and on\-boarding process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition at TA@Buckland.com
  
As we receive a high volume of applications, we’re only able to contact candidates selected to move forward. While we truly appreciate your interest, we are unable to respond to general inquiries regarding application status. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.title: Deskside Support Technician
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  

Exchange Technology Services is a leading IT consulting company in Winnipeg and part of the Exchange Income Corporation's family of companies. We provide a wide range of services, including Managed IT, Project Management, Business Intelligence, Cyber Security, Digital Transformation, Training Services, Installation Services, and Telecommunications across Canada and the US.
  
  

If you are looking for a fast\-paced career, serving enterprise customers and managing diverse IT projects, we invite you to join us.
  
  

Our work environment is dynamic, filled with learning opportunities, exciting and challenging projects, and a chance to make a positive impact on clients’ businesses. We value teamwork, fun, and achieving amazing results together.
  
  

JOB OVERVIEW
  
Reporting to the Service Desk Manager and working closely with the Provisioning Team Lead, the Deskside Support Technician is responsible for providing technical support to end\-users, troubleshooting issues, deploying and maintaining hardware at client sites, and providing excellent customer service in line with client service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
* Managing incidents and requests, ensuring timely resolution of high\-priority and time\-sensitive requests
* Using ConnectWise Manage (CWM) to manage, document, and update all assigned service tickets, including accurately logging mileage and field time
* Maintaining documentation, including accurate logs of technical activities, hardware changes, and client interactions
* Communication with clients regularly, including coordinating service calls, installations, and preventive maintenance
* Offer both onsite and remote support for computer hardware, software applications, incident troubleshooting, and configuration to an assigned group of client companies
* Deliver responsive, professional on\-site support for desktops, laptops, peripherals, network connectivity, and basic server functions, including assisting clients in real time with requests raised through the Service Desk
* Maintain clear and timely communication with Service Desk staff, keeping them informed of any planned site visits during normal business hours, including the expected time of return
* Be available to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, when situations or business needs arise and urgent client site work is required
* Collaborate with Hardware Analysts and the Provisioning Team Lead, as needed, to deploy, configure, and retrieve hardware
* Maintain asset tracking records and documentation for hardware deliveries and returns, and track IT tools, hardware inventory, and consumables
* Participate in IT Services as assigned (e.g., backups/restoration, thread prevention, etc.)
* Submit regular performance and incident reports
* Attend mandatory weekly/monthly team meetings and contribute to team discussions and service improvement initiative
* Follow internal policies, data protection protocols, and industry\-standard safety procedures
* Maintain a professional appearance by wearing company\-branded attire during all client visits
* Additional responsibilities as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS
  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE
  
* Bachelor’s degree or College diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field considered an asset
* 2\+ years of experience in a Field Services or/and Desktop Support role within the IT industry required
* Previous experience with MS Office applications, Office 365, SharePoint/One Drive, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Exchange required
* Previous experience building and repairing computer hardware, and a working knowledge of past and existing computer hardware components \& technologies required
* Previous experience with Active Directory, Domain Services, and Windows Operating Systems (Consumer/Server) required
* Working knowledge of imaging tools, endpoint protection platforms, and troubleshooting networking issues and standard enterprise hardware required
* Familiarity with ConnectWise Manage or similar service management/ticketing systems required
* Previous experience in a Customer Service or/and Helpdesk Environment is preferred.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES
  
* Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills
* Analytical skills with the ability to solve complex issues
* Excellent customer support and customer service skills
* Strong interpersonal skills with a client\-focused mindset
* Ability to work well in a team
* Strong ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Proactive, results\-driven approach to problem\-solving in the field
* Professional verbal and written communication skills
* Must possess a valid driver’s licence and be willing to travel regularly to client locations
* Experience in a fast\-paced environment with multitasking responsibilities


WORKING CONDITIONS
  
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a clear criminal record check
* Physically able to perform all listed job duties
* Able to lift and carry up to 50lbs
* This role involves working in a variety of environments and includes regular interaction with staff and members of the public
* Field\-based role requiring daily travel to client sites and head office
* Company van (Subject to availability) and tools provided for work\-related duties.
* On Call/Shiftwork as required to provide after\-hour client support, including occasional weekend work for critical support tasks
* Various shifts at a fast pace to meet service level requirements of our clients


Methods and procedures described or implied in the job profile may be altered to accommodate employees.

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Registered Retirement Savings Plan with Company Matching
* Employee Share Purchase Plan
* Onsite Gym
* Subsidized Phone Plan
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* Collaborative and innovative work environment

jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as an IT Support Technician and become a vital part of ensuring seamless technology operations across our organization! In this role, you will provide proactive technical support, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and assist users in optimizing their digital tools. Your energetic approach will help foster a productive environment where technology empowers every team member to succeed. Whether working on desktop support, network configurations, or resolving technical glitches, you’ll play a key role in maintaining our IT infrastructure’s efficiency and security.

**Responsibilities**

* Deliver prompt and effective technical support to end\-users via help desk channels, resolving issues related to operating systems, software applications, and hardware components.
* Troubleshoot computer hardware problems, including desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals, ensuring minimal downtime.
* Configure and maintain computer networks, including LAN (Local Area Network), VPN (Virtual Private Network), firewalls, and Wi\-Fi connectivity to ensure secure and reliable access.
* Assist with operating system management across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms, performing updates and system optimizations.
* Manage incident tickets using ServiceNow or BMC Remedy to document issues accurately and track resolution progress.
* Support software troubleshooting efforts for applications like Microsoft Office suite and other enterprise tools.
* Collaborate with team members to implement security measures such as firewall configurations and network access controls to protect organizational data.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of operating systems including Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
* Experience with computer networking concepts such as LAN setup, VPN configuration, firewalls, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
* Proficiency in using ticketing systems like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy for incident management.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly explain technical solutions to non\-technical users.
* Familiarity with help desk procedures and customer service best practices to deliver a positive support experience.
* Ability to troubleshoot software issues related to operating systems and productivity applications like Microsoft Office.
* Understanding of hardware components including desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals.

Join us in delivering exceptional IT support that keeps our organization running smoothly! Your enthusiasm for technology combined with your technical expertise will make a real difference in empowering our teams every day.

Pay: $20\.00\-$35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
**Build What Matters**


At Graham, one of North America’s largest general contractors, we don’t just build projects, we enable the systems and services that make construction possible. As part of our Corporate Services team, you’ll support impactful work across the region through expertise in HR Advisory, Communications, Supply Chain, Finance, and more.


Here, your work has purpose. Your growth is supported. And your impact is lasting.


Join a team that builds with commitment, reliability, and integrity. Apply today and help us build what matters.

 **About The Role**


In the IT Services Analyst role, you will be providing first line support to Graham’s internal customers and stakeholders which includes project site staff, office, and corporate services staff. Your caring and energetic approach will help solve incidents, fulfill requests, and allow our customers to get back to focusing on Graham’s operations as quickly as possible. Maintain excellent customer experience is our primary goal and and must be a driven individual to achieve a high quality of work. You will be empowered along with your team to seek opportunities to improve service levels. Improvements can occur through automation, streamlining and simplification of processes or offering education on new advancements in technology. Your Coach and Leader, the IT Services Team Lead, will help foster your growth and ensure you have everything you need to succeed.

 **May include the following repsonsibilties:**

* Work through multiple customer incidents, requests and tasks through to completion
* Empathize with our customers to help them through their requests regardless of their standing in the organization
* Prioritize issues based on the severity/impact and escalate to specialists when required
* Demonstrate agile troubleshooting skills for desktops, laptops, cellular, basic networking and applications
* Communicate effectively and liaise between technical and non\-technical customers
* Prioritize multiple tasks and incidents to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction
* Know your strengths and limitations, remain curious and treat every interaction as an opportunity to learn
* Suggest new and creative ways to improve the support experience in collaboration with your peers
* Assess daily workload requirements and make changes as required based on priorities

 **Minimum Requirements**

* Diploma or degree in Computer Science or related discipline
* 2\+ years of experience in a Customer Service delivery role
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Suite (Windows, desktop, SharePoint, Active Directory, Exchange and Office 365\)
* Fundamental knowledge of networking concepts like switching, routing and VPN as well as internet connectivity using cellular, satellite, ADSL, cable and fiber
* Driven, ambitious and energetic personality, with the ability to work with various skill levels
* Excellent time management and customer service skills
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, virtually or through written text
* Ability to work calmly under pressure, understand and adhere to workflow processes
* Ability to understand IT acronyms and translate them effectively to customers
* Ability to translate user challengers and offer the best expertise to support
* Proficiency in troubleshooting network, desktop,cellular, and other infrastructure related hardware and software

 **Lay the Foundation for Your Next Career Move. Apply Today.**

jobs.title: Service Desk Technician
Technical Support Specialist – Software
jobs.description:
**About Mobiltex**

Mobiltex is an IIoT and software company delivering remote monitoring and software solutions that help maintain pipeline health for industries delivering critical services. Individual solutions target corrosion prevention, gas pressure management, and water network optimization, primarily serving midstream and downstream energy operators, and water utilities.

Mobiltex is a high\-growth company in an active phase of product and organizational scaling, with potential for M\&A, as well as a growing international footprint. This is an environment that rewards people who can build structure where it doesn’t yet exist, and drive commercial output as the organization scales.

**Role Summary**

The **Technical Support Specialist** **– Software** is a frontline role responsible for delivering technical support and training, while serving as a critical link between the customers and service, engineering, sales, and product teams. It combines software support expertise with customer engagement to support deployment, adoption, and ongoing performance of IoT solutions across our energy and water verticals.

This is an early\-career role in the support team, reporting to the Support Manager. It's a strong entry point for someone with technical skills who enjoys working with people to build product and troubleshooting expertise and grow into a senior support or implementation role over time. The primary focus will be support of Mobiltex software and will include some support of Mobiltex hardware devices. This position is also a great fit for corrosion/CP field professionals looking to move into support, or for IT helpdesk, telecom, electronics, or customer service people with strong technical curiosity; we'll train the domain side either way.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support across the software portfolio: primarily CorInsights, and also FloInsights, Osprey, and future products. Secondarily, provide hardware support as needed for CorTalk, FloPath, and future products.
* Respond to support tickets with a focus on responsiveness, clarity, and resolution quality.
* Communicate clearly with customers, translating technical issues into understandable terms and helping customers use our products successfully.
* Diagnose problems methodically and identify root causes, workarounds, and solutions.
* Escalate complex or high\-impact issues to senior support, management, sales, or engineering.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with the product, development, and QA teams as needed to investigate bugs and contribute to ongoing software improvements.
* Monitor key performance metrics and service levels to ensure you consistently meet or exceed personal targets and company targets.
* Utilize and continuously improve internal documentation, knowledge bases, and support protocols by following Mobiltex standards for formatting, creation, and peer review.
* Participate in customer meetings or presentations when needed to resolve high\-stakes support issues or build customer confidence.
* Provide occasional after\-hours or on\-call support for critical or high\-impact issues.
* Minimal travel (5% or less) for customer meetings, team meetings, and industry events.

**How You'll Work**

You will use phone, email, and ticketing systems to communicate with customers and track resolutions and defects internally. There will be occasional opportunities for on\-site customer engagement. Strong verbal and written communication skills are fundamental to success.

You'll learn and use AI tools like Claude and Copilot alongside standard support tools to work faster and more consistently: drafting case responses, summarizing ticket threads before escalation, searching the knowledge base for similar issues, and generating first\-draft articles from resolved cases for peer review and publishing.

If you are based in Calgary, your first three months will have more office\-based work to get hands\-on training and learn alongside the team. After that, you'll work a hybrid mix of office and home days.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in software customer support or service technician roles.
* A bachelor's degree, diploma, AMPP CP1 or CP2 certification, certification in a related field, or equivalent experience in pipeline monitoring, industrial software, or related fields.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience providing phone or email support to customers in a remote work environment and/or with remote teams.
* Experience with support ticketing systems, remote desktop tools, and diagnostic utilities (Salesforce, Teams, Slack, Jira, Confluence).
* Troubleshooting skills with knowledge of SaaS platforms, APIs, and database technologies.
* Knowledge of and/or willingness to use, create, and promote knowledge bases and AI tools (Claude, Copilot).

Location: Calgary; Remote considered

**What Mobiltex Offers**

* A role in a company actively reshaping how critical infrastructure is monitored and managed.
* Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over commercial messaging and market presence.
* A function with clear scope and a defined growth path as Mobiltex scales – with senior leadership visibility from day one.
* Competitive compensation including base salary and performance incentives.
* Hybrid flexibility with periodic travel to trade shows, team meetings and customer events.

Mobiltex is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to mental or physical disabilities, family status, marital status, sex or gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, religion or creed, nationality or citizenship, national or ethnic place of origin, ancestry, or race or color.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist (Microsoft & End-User Support)
jobs.description:
**About RebalanceMD**

RebalanceMD Victoria is a specialty care clinic where physicians, surgeons, physiotherapists, and allied health professionals work together as one multidisciplinary team. At RebalanceMD, patients can access coordinated care through an integrated model designed to support assessment, treatment, recovery, and ongoing health. Behind that care is a strong technology foundation and commitment to innovation that keep our clinical and administrative teams connected, secure, and able to deliver an exceptional patient and provider experience.

We are seeking a Technical Support Specialist who is passionate about technology and service, and who understands the critical role IT plays in a healthcare environment. This role is instrumental in ensuring our clinical and administrative teams can operate seamlessly, securely, and without disruption.

**About the Role**

As a Technical Support Specialist at RebalanceMD, you will be the first point of contact for technical support across the organization. You will provide timely, professional assistance to a diverse group of users including doctors, clinicians, administrative staff, and leadership.

This role requires a strong foundation in Microsoft technologies, hands\-on support of end\-user hardware, and the ability to work within a fast\-paced clinical environment where responsiveness and reliability are essential. Experience with Apple devices is also valuable, as our environment includes a mix of platforms.

Success in this role requires excellent communication skills, a proactive mindset, and a commitment to supporting healthcare teams in delivering high\-quality patient care.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Tier 1/2 support to clinical and administrative staff via in\-person, phone, email, and ticketing system
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues with a strong sense of urgency and professionalism
* Support Microsoft technologies including Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint), and Active Directory/Entra ID
* Set up, configure, and maintain end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices
* Support both Windows\-based systems and Apple devices within a clinical and office environment
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes, including account provisioning, equipment setup, and access management
* Ensure all systems and devices comply with organizational security standards and healthcare privacy requirements (e.g., PHIPA/PIPEDA awareness)
* Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, resolutions, and IT procedures within the help desk system
* Perform routine maintenance, updates, and patching to ensure system stability and security
* Support clinical workflows by minimizing downtime and ensuring critical systems remain operational
* Educate staff on best practices for technology use, security awareness, and basic troubleshooting

**Qualifications \& Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field and a minimum of 2 years' experience in an IT help desk or end\-user support role

* Strong experience supporting Microsoft environments, including Windows OS and Microsoft 365
* Working knowledge of Entra ID user and device management
* Experience supporting end\-user hardware such as laptops, desktops, printers, and mobile devices
* Familiarity with Apple macOS and basic troubleshooting of MacBooks
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including Wi\-Fi, VPN, and TCP/IP
* Experience with ticketing systems and remote support tools
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly and respectfully support non\-technical users in a clinical setting
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to prioritize and respond effectively in time\-sensitive situations
* A customer\-focused mindset with a high level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail

**Nice to Have**

* IT certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Microsoft certifications, or similar
* Experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, JAMF, SCCM)
* Previous experience in a healthcare or clinical environment
* Familiarity with electronic medical record (EMR) systems or healthcare applications
* Knowledge of cybersecurity and data privacy best practices in healthcare

**Compensation**

RebalanceMD offers competitive compensation, a beautiful and bright office, amazing and supportive team of co\-workers and a vibrant atmosphere!  
Please outline any relevant experience you may have as well as why you are interested in joining our team in your response to this posting.
